naruto.summary: In the Hidden Leaf Village, a young ninja shunned by his peers carries a powerful fox demon sealed inside him at birth. Determined to become Hokage and earn the recognition he has been denied, he grows stronger with his Team 7 teammates through missions and shinobi wars, while trying to bring back a friend who has turned to darkness.

one-piece.summary: A young man with a rubber body sets sail to gather a colorful crew and find the legendary treasure of the Pirate King. Every island reveals a new world and new friendships, while his dream of freedom clashes with a sprawling World Government.

aot.summary: Humanity survives behind enormous walls, its only protection against man-eating giants. After his hometown is destroyed, a young man joins an elite corps to take revenge, only to discover that the truth about the Titans and the outside world is far more complex than he imagined.
aot.title: Attack on Titan

death-note.summary: A brilliant but jaded high schooler finds a supernatural notebook that kills anyone whose name is written in it. Convinced he can cleanse the world of crime, he becomes a self-proclaimed vigilante, drawn into a battle of wits with a detective determined to stop him.

mha.summary: In a world where most people have a unique power called a Quirk, a boy born without one dreams of becoming the greatest hero. Spotted by the Symbol of Peace, he enters a prestigious academy where he must catch up with overpowered classmates.

demon-slayer.summary: After his family is slaughtered by a demon, a young charcoal seller sets out to avenge them and save his little sister, who has been turned into a demon. He joins a corps of slayers who use ancestral breathing techniques.

jjk.summary: An ordinary high schooler swallows a cursed finger to save his friends and unwillingly becomes the host of a feared demonic entity. Recruited by a school of sorcerers, he learns to wield cursed energy while hunting for the creature's other fingers.

chainsaw-man.summary: A young man buried in debt merges with his chainsaw devil dog and becomes a devil hunter with destructive power. Between bloody fights and a search for simple happiness, he navigates a world where devils are born from human fears.

hxh.summary: A young boy sets out to take the Hunter Exam, the path to a worldwide elite with huge privileges, to find his missing father. His journey leads him through ever stranger trials, alongside friends as gifted as they are endearing.

fmab.summary: Two brothers who tried to bring their mother back with alchemy pay the price by losing their bodies. They travel their country searching for the Philosopher's Stone to recover what they lost, uncovering a far larger national conspiracy.

dbz.summary: A warrior from a vanished planet defends Earth against ever more powerful threats, from alien invaders to artificial creatures. Through extreme training and titanic battles, he builds a lineage of legendary fighters.

bleach.summary: A high schooler who can see ghosts accidentally inherits the powers of a Soul Reaper and must now protect souls from evil spirits. He discovers a parallel world ruled by strict laws and fearsome hierarchies.

tokyo-revengers.summary: A young man with no future discovers he can travel back into his own past, to the exact moment his ex-girlfriend was killed by a gang. He then tries to change the course of events to save the people he loved in middle school.

spy-x-family.summary: An elite spy must build a fake family for an undercover mission, unaware that his wife is an assassin and his adopted daughter a telepath. Each one hides their secrets from the other two in this family spy comedy.

vinland-saga.summary: A young Viking grows up obsessed with revenge after seeing his father killed before his eyes, becoming a fearsome warrior serving his father's murderer. His bloody quest gradually leads him to question the very meaning of war and vengeance.

code-geass.summary: An exiled prince receives the supernatural power to force anyone to obey him and uses it to lead a masked rebellion against the empire that destroyed his family. A brilliant strategist, he wavers between his ideals and the sacrifices his war demands.

fairy-tail.summary: A young wizard joins a colorful mages' guild known for its chaotic missions and the unwavering loyalty of its members. She forms strong friendships while facing rival guilds and ever greater magical threats.

sao.summary: Thousands of players are trapped in a virtual reality game where dying in the game means dying for real. A solo player must climb the floors of a giant dungeon to one day win back their freedom, while protecting the people he meets.

haikyu.summary: A short but volleyball-crazy high schooler joins a team that is rebuilding, determined to prove that height isn't everything on the court. This sports series follows the team's technical and collective growth all the way to the national stage.

black-clover.summary: In a world where magic determines social status, a boy born with no magic at all still dreams of becoming the most powerful mage in the kingdom. His raw determination and perseverance make him an unexpected rival to far more gifted mages.

dr-stone.summary: All of humanity is petrified by a mysterious phenomenon for thousands of years. When he wakes up, a science-genius high schooler sets out to rebuild civilization from scratch, relying on the scientific method rather than brute force.

promised-neverland.summary: In a seemingly idyllic orphanage, a group of gifted children discovers the horrifying truth about their future and plans a meticulous escape against a threat far smarter than they are.

rezero.summary: A young man transported to a parallel world discovers that he comes back to life every time he dies, reliving the same events until he finds the right outcome. This isolating power pushes him into ever heavier psychological sacrifices.

steins-gate.summary: An eccentric student accidentally builds a device that can send messages into the past, triggering catastrophic and unforeseen consequences. He must then navigate between world lines to repair what he broke.

cowboy-bebop.summary: A crew of jaded bounty hunters roams the solar system aboard their ship, taking job after job and meeting strange characters, with a mix of humor, melancholy and stylish gunfights, all set to jazz.

mob-psycho.summary: A middle schooler with colossal psychic powers tries to live a normal life and suppress his emotions so he never loses control. Working part-time for a fake psychic, he moves between comic absurdity and very real supernatural threats.

assassination-classroom.summary: A class of outcast middle schoolers is given an unlikely mission: assassinate their teacher, an overpowered creature threatening to destroy Earth, before the end of the school year. Between gags and life lessons, an unexpected bond forms.

seven-deadly-sins.summary: A princess on the run recruits the scattered members of a legendary order of knights, wrongly accused of treason, to take back her kingdom from a corrupt Holy Knight order. Each member hides an extraordinary power and past.

kaguya-sama.summary: Two top students at an elite high school are in love with each other, but out of sheer pride neither will be the first to confess. What follows is a psychological war as absurd as it is hilarious, where every everyday gesture becomes a strategic battlefield.

overlord.summary: When a cult online role-playing game shuts down its servers for good, a lone player finds himself trapped in his character's body: a powerful skeleton sorcerer ruling over a dungeon full of NPCs who now have minds of their own. He sets out to conquer this new world with his loyal army.

tensei-slime.summary: An office worker killed by accident is reincarnated in a fantasy world as a simple slime. With formidable absorption powers, he gradually founds a thriving nation where humans and monsters live together in peace.

konosuba.summary: An otaku teenager dies in a ridiculous way and is offered a second life in a fantasy world, along with a clumsy goddess he picked himself. Together they form an adventuring party as incompetent as it is lovable, stumbling from one hilarious disaster to the next.

shield-hero.summary: Summoned to a parallel world as one of four legendary heroes, a young man is given the weakest-looking weapon of all: a simple shield. Betrayed and slandered from the start, he must rebuild his reputation by developing new defensive strategies.

one-punch-man-anime.summary: The anime adaptation of the cult manga: a hero so strong he beats any opponent with a single punch is bored to death for lack of a real challenge. A hilarious parody of superhero tropes, driven by spectacular animation.

tokyo-ghoul-anime.summary: The anime adaptation of the manga: an ordinary student is turned into a half-human, half-ghoul after a near-fatal encounter, forcing him to navigate a hidden world where ghouls feed on humans while fighting to keep his humanity.

blue-lock-anime.summary: The anime adaptation of the manga: after a painful World Cup defeat, the Japanese football federation locks three hundred promising strikers inside a ruthless training center, where only one will survive to become the selfish goal scorer the national team needs.

violet-evergarden.summary: A former child soldier, shaped for war and cut off from her emotions, becomes a ghostwriter after the conflict. By writing letters for others, she slowly tries to understand the meaning of the words her former commander said to her before he vanished.

your-lie-in-april.summary: A young piano prodigy who can no longer play since a trauma linked to his mother has his life turned upside down by an eccentric, vibrant violinist. She gradually helps him learn to feel music, and to live, again.

toradora.summary: A high schooler with a delinquent's face but a homemaker's heart teams up with the most feared girl in his class so they can help each other win over the people they love. An unlikely friendship slowly turns into something deeper.

fruits-basket.summary: An orphaned high school girl taken in by a mysterious family discovers that some of its members turn into animals of the Chinese zodiac whenever they are hugged by someone of the opposite sex. Her kindness gradually heals the deep wounds of this cursed family.

evangelion.summary: In a future ravaged by disasters, a teenager is reluctantly recruited to pilot a giant biomechanical robot against mysterious beings threatening humanity. Behind the spectacular battles lies a deep dive into the fractured psychology of its young pilots.

jojo.summary: Across several generations of the same cursed family, the saga follows various heirs of the Joestar name in their fights against supernatural forces, using spiritual manifestations called Stands. A flamboyant visual style unique in the shonen landscape.

made-in-abyss.summary: In a world where a giant, unexplored chasm holds treasures as well as unspeakable horrors, a young orphan girl descends into its depths to find her missing mother, accompanied by a mysterious human-looking robot.

erased.summary: A young manga artist with the power to go back a few minutes in time before a tragedy is suddenly sent eighteen years into the past, to the time of an unsolved child kidnapping case. He must solve the case before it happens again.

hells-paradise.summary: A ninja sentenced to death is offered a chance at a pardon: explore a mysterious island in search of an elixir of immortality for the shogun, alongside other criminals and their executioners. The island teems with supernatural creatures and dangers far more terrifying than expected.

mushoku-tensei.summary: A 34-year-old Japanese shut-in, killed in an accident, is reincarnated in a world of magic as a baby, keeping all his memories. Determined not to waste this second chance, he resolves to live life to the fullest, with no regrets this time.

apothecary-diaries.summary: In imperial China, a young apothecary sold as a servant to the palace uses her knowledge of herbs to solve the mysteries and poisonous intrigues shaking the court, while trying not to draw too much attention.

bocchi-the-rock.summary: A high school guitarist with crazy talent but crippling social anxiety dreams of joining a band without ever having had the courage to talk to anyone. Her chaotic arrival in an existing band turns her reclusive life upside down.

oshi-no-ko.summary: A gynecologist who is a fan of a popular idol ends up delivering her twins, then dies and is reborn as one of her own children. He then discovers, from the inside, the ruthless and sometimes criminal backstage of the Japanese entertainment industry.

dandadan.summary: A high school girl who believes in ghosts and a classmate convinced aliens exist challenge each other to prove their beliefs, and end up dragged into an adventure where both turn out to be very real.

ranking-of-kings.summary: A small, deaf young prince, underestimated by his whole kingdom because of his disability, still dreams of becoming the greatest king in history. With a mysterious shadow who has become his loyal friend, he learns to turn his apparent weaknesses into strengths.

devilman-crybaby.summary: A pure-hearted teenager merges with a demon to fight demons from within, keeping his humanity despite terrifying destructive strength. A dark, visceral reimagining of a classic, about the loss of innocence and human cruelty.

samurai-champloo.summary: Two swordsmen with completely opposite styles are saved from execution by a young waitress, and in return they promise to help her find a mysterious samurai who smells of sunflowers. A picaresque road trip through feudal Japan, set to hip-hop.

death-parade.summary: In a mysterious bar open only to the dead, an enigmatic bartender puts souls through deadly games that reveal their true nature, deciding whether they will be reincarnated or vanish. Each episode features a new pair facing this chilling judgment.

great-pretender.summary: A talented but reckless Japanese con man is dragged into the international scams of a mysterious high-level organization, taking him from Los Angeles to Singapore in a series of ever bolder heists.

golden-kamuy-anime.summary: The anime adaptation of the manga: in early 20th-century Hokkaido, a hardened war veteran teams up with a young Ainu girl to find a hidden gold treasure whose location is tattooed on the skin of escaped prisoners.

frieren-anime.summary: After the death of the hero who defeated the Demon King, the near-immortal elf mage Frieren realizes too late how little she valued her time with her human companions. Decades later, she sets out again to better understand the short lives around her, accompanied by a young apprentice.

spice-and-wolf.summary: A young traveling merchant picks up a centuries-old wolf goddess, no longer revered as the protector of the harvest, who wants to return to her homeland. Together they travel medieval trade routes, between clever bargaining and growing closeness.

hyouka.summary: An energy-conserving high schooler reluctantly joins his school's classic literature club, where a classmate's insatiable curiosity drags him into solving small everyday school mysteries.

bunny-girl-senpai.summary: In a library, a high schooler runs into a famous actress wearing a strange bunny costume, invisible to everyone but him. He then discovers "Puberty Syndrome", a supernatural phenomenon tied to teenagers' emotional wounds.

anohana.summary: Childhood friends torn apart by the tragic death of one of them reunite years later when her ghost appears to one of them, asking for a forgotten wish to be granted. A heartbreaking story about grief and reconciliation.

angel-beats.summary: A high schooler wakes up with no memories in a timeless school full of teenagers who died young, where an armed group wages an absurd rebellion against God himself. Behind the action and humor lies a moving reflection on grief and acceptance.

dragon-maid.summary: A lonely programmer, after an unexpected encounter, takes in a dragon who has turned into a devoted maid. Their unlikely life together turns the young woman's homebody routine upside down.

ancient-magus-bride.summary: A teenage girl with nowhere to belong sells herself at auction and is bought by a mysterious mage with an animal skull for a head, who makes her both his apprentice and his future bride. A fantasy tale blending ancient magic and a search for belonging.

bloom-into-you.summary: A high school girl who has never felt romantic excitement despite several confessions is asked out by the student council president, a girl everyone admires. She must now deal with feelings she doesn't yet understand.

my-little-monster.summary: A cold, serious high school girl focused only on her studies has her life turned upside down by an impulsive, antisocial classmate, as intense in his anger as in his growing affection for her.

snow-white-red-hair.summary: A young herbalist with flaming red hair, pursued by a prince who wants to make her his concubine, flees to a neighboring kingdom where she befriends its kind and protective second prince.

nozaki-kun.summary: A high school girl confesses to the popular boy she loves, only to discover he is actually a successful shojo romance manga artist working under a pen name, who immediately recruits her as his assistant without noticing her real feelings.

charlotte.summary: A high schooler who can briefly possess other people's bodies thanks to a supernatural power is recruited by the student council of a special academy, tasked with finding other teens with similar abilities before they get exploited.

katanagatari.summary: A swordsman who grew up cut off from the world on a remote island, trained in a martial art that uses no weapon, is recruited by a cunning strategist to recover twelve legendary swords scattered across the country.

beyond-the-boundary.summary: A nearly immortal half-human high schooler meets a girl who can turn her own blood into a weapon and hunts evil beings born from negative human emotions. An encounter that changes both their lonely destinies.

ao-haru-ride.summary: A high school girl who has completely changed since middle school runs into the quiet boy she loved back then, now transformed and distant. She tries to reconnect with him despite the years and everything left unsaid.

ghost-in-the-shell-sac.summary: In a cybernetic future where bodies and minds can be partly or fully artificial, the major of an elite counter-terrorism unit hunts down dizzyingly complex cybercrimes, constantly questioning the line between human and machine.

trigun.summary: On a desert planet that looks like the Wild West, a pacifist gunman with a record bounty drifts from town to town, chased by bounty hunters and haunted by a destructive past he refuses to repeat.

rurouni-kenshin.summary: At the start of the Meiji era, a former legendary assassin who swore never to kill again wanders Japan with a reverse-blade sword, trying to atone for his bloody past by protecting the innocent.

inuyasha.summary: A middle school girl sent to feudal Japan through a mysterious well accidentally frees a half-dog demon sealed for decades. Together they set out to find the scattered shards of a jewel with fearsome powers.

yu-yu-hakusho.summary: A delinquent high schooler dies saving a child and is given a second chance as a Spirit Detective, tasked with investigating demon incursions into the human world.

elfen-lied.summary: A mutant with invisible arms that can slice through matter escapes a military lab after a bloody massacre and loses her memory as she flees. Taken in by two young people who know nothing about her nature, she tries to build a normal life despite the violence that catches up with her.

higurashi.summary: A teenager who has just moved to a remote village gradually discovers that local traditions hide a series of unexplained murders and disappearances that repeat every year during a festival. Reality itself seems to break into unsettling loops.

fate-zero.summary: Seven mages each summon a legendary hero as a Servant to fight in a secret war that will decide who obtains the power of the Holy Grail, capable of granting any wish.

psycho-pass.summary: In a future where an all-seeing system measures every citizen's latent criminality in real time, a young idealistic inspector joins a police unit tasked with neutralizing people deemed dangerous before they even act.

durarara.summary: A high schooler who has just arrived in Ikebukuro discovers a district full of rival gangs, mysterious informants and a headless rider on a black motorcycle. The fates of dozens of residents intertwine in an unpredictable urban ensemble story.

no-game-no-life.summary: A reclusive brother and sister, undefeated in every game, are transported to a parallel world where all conflicts, even over territory, are settled exclusively through games. Together, they set out to conquer the entire world.

baccano.summary: In 1930s America, the fates of immortal alchemists, mobsters and train robbers collide aboard a transcontinental train, in a non-linear story mixing dark comedy and over-the-top violence.

clannad.summary: A jaded, cynical high schooler meets a fragile classmate who loves theater and dreams of reviving her school's drama club despite her poor health. A moving story about family, grief and resilience.

k-on.summary: Four high school girls join their school's light music club to save it from being shut down, gradually discovering the joy of playing in a band between chaotic rehearsals and endless tea breaks.

gintama.summary: In an alternate Edo invaded by aliens who banned samurai from carrying swords, a jaded former warrior runs an odd-jobs agency, taking on absurd gigs and wild parodies between moments of unexpected seriousness.

sailor-moon.summary: A clumsy middle school girl discovers she is the reincarnation of a legendary warrior tasked with protecting Earth alongside other costumed heroines, while juggling the far more down-to-earth worries of teenage life.

hajime-no-ippo.summary: A shy, bullied high schooler discovers his calling for boxing after a professional boxer saves him from a fight. He slowly climbs the ranks of this demanding sport, discovering a determination he never knew he had.

parasyte.summary: An ordinary high schooler narrowly escapes having his whole body taken over by an alien parasite, which ends up confined to his right hand. Forced to coexist, they must face other parasites that have taken over entire humans.

kuroko.summary: Tetsuya Kuroko, the quiet shadow of Teiko Middle School, joins Seirin High with Taiga Kagami to beat the five former prodigies of the Generation of Miracles. A basketball anime mixing spectacular techniques and intense rivalries.

slam-dunk-anime.summary: Hanamichi Sakuragi, a delinquent rejected by fifty girls, joins Shohoku's basketball team out of love for Haruko. He discovers a real passion and takes on the best high schools in the region.

ace-of-diamond.summary: Eijun Sawamura, a fiery pitcher from the countryside, joins prestigious Seido High to reach Koshien. He faces fierce internal competition and formidable rivals.

prince-of-tennis.summary: Ryoma Echizen, a young tennis prodigy back from the United States, joins Seigaku Middle School's club. With his teammates, he fights his way to the national championship against opponents with supernatural shots.

yuri-on-ice.summary: Yuri Katsuki, a Japanese figure skater broken after a Grand Prix failure, sees his career revived when legend Victor Nikiforov becomes his coach. A unique relationship grows on the ice.

eyeshield-21.summary: Sena Kobayakawa, the school's punching bag, becomes the mysterious running back Eyeshield 21 of an American football team. He aims for the Christmas Bowl championship.

ping-pong.summary: Two childhood friends, the confident Peco and the reserved Smile, rise through competitive table tennis amid talent, doubt and passion. An unusual art style by Masaaki Yuasa.

fire-force.summary: Shinra Kusakabe, nicknamed the Devil, joins Special Fire Force Company 8 to fight the Infernals, humans turned into flames. He seeks the truth about the fire that killed his family.

soul-eater-anime.summary: At the Death Weapon Meister Academy, meisters and their demon weapons collect souls to create a Death Scythe. Maka Albarn and Soul Eater face the witch Medusa and the shadow of madness.

noragami.summary: Yato, a minor god without a shrine, takes odd jobs for 5 yen. He meets Hiyori, a middle schooler who has become half-ghost, and Yukine, his new shinki.

blue-exorcist.summary: Rin Okumura learns he is the son of Satan, and the blue flame in his blood drives him to become an exorcist. He trains at True Cross Academy to defeat his father.

akame-ga-kill.summary: Tatsumi, a young warrior who came to the capital, joins Night Raid, a group of assassins fighting a corrupt Empire. Imperial weapons and sacrifices mark a merciless war.

magi.summary: Aladdin, a young magician with a mysterious flute, sets out with Alibaba to conquer dungeons full of legendary treasures. He discovers powerful Djinn and a world of political stakes.

hellsing-ultimate.summary: The Hellsing Organization protects England from creatures of the night with its ultimate weapon, the vampire Alucard. A new threat, the Major and his Nazi battalion, unleashes a bloody war on London.

gurren-lagann.summary: In an underground world, young Simon and hot-blooded Kamina find a mecha and break through to the surface. Their rebellion against the Beastmen grows into an epic on the scale of the universe.

kill-la-kill.summary: Ryuko Matoi arrives at Honnouji Academy to find out who killed her father. She takes on the student council, which rules through uniforms that grant powers.

flcl.summary: Naota, a jaded middle schooler, has his life turned upside down when a strange girl on a Vespa smashes his head with a guitar. Robots start bursting out of his forehead in a wild town.

darker-than-black.summary: Since Hell's Gate appeared, humans with powers called Contractors act as ruthless agents. Hei, nicknamed the Black Reaper, carries out missions for a secret syndicate.

black-lagoon.summary: Rokuro Okajima, a Japanese office worker, is kidnapped by modern pirates and joins their crew. In the city of Roanapur, he survives among mobs and mercenaries.

gto-anime.summary: Eikichi Onizuka, a former biker gang leader, becomes a teacher at a private school. With his unusual methods, he tries to help his troubled students.

nana.summary: Two young women both named Nana, with opposite personalities, meet on the train to Tokyo. Their life as roommates and their love lives drive a story full of music and emotion.

ouran.summary: Haruhi Fujioka, a scholarship student, breaks an outrageously expensive vase and has to join the Ouran Academy Host Club. These charming young men mistake her for a boy.

horimiya.summary: Kyoko Hori, a popular high school girl, hides a busy family life, and Izumi Miyamura, a quiet student, hides piercings and tattoos. A chance meeting lets them reveal their true selves to each other.

my-dress-up-darling.summary: Wakana Gojo, a high schooler passionate about Hina dolls, befriends Marin Kitagawa, a popular girl who loves cosplay. He helps her make her costumes and discovers a whole new world.

grand-blue.summary: Iori Kitahara moves to the seaside for university and ends up in a diving club more into drinking than diving. His days are full of nonsense, booze and rowdy friendships.

kaiji.summary: Kaiji Ito, a young man buried in debt with no future, is forced to take part in gambling games where his life is at stake. He must outwit unscrupulous manipulators.

cyberpunk-edgerunners.summary: In Night City, David, a teenager from the poor districts, loses everything and dives into the dangerous life of edgerunners, mercenaries loaded with cybernetic implants. Between ambition, love and technology eating away at his body, he races toward a blazing destiny.

lycoris-recoil.summary: In Japan, a secret organization called the DA trains teenage girl agents known as Lycoris to stop crimes before they happen. Chisato, an elite Lycoris who was sent away, now works in a café with Takina, a very strict new recruit.

solo-leveling.summary: In a world where portals open onto dungeons, Sung Jinwoo is the weakest hunter of all. After a near-fatal event, he gains a secret system that lets him level up without limit.

kaiju-no-8.summary: In a Japan ravaged by giant monsters, Kafka Hibino, a thirty-something kaiju cleaner, dreams of joining the Defense Force. He swallows a mysterious little monster and turns into a kaiju who can keep his mind.

sakamoto-days.summary: Taro Sakamoto was a legendary hitman feared by everyone. Now married with a child, he has retired to run a small convenience store. But his past catches up with him, and he must protect his family while keeping a low profile.

mashle.summary: In a world where magic decides everyone's worth, Mash Burnedead is born without any magic. He trains only his body and enters a magic academy to take on the elite with his muscles.

undead-unluck.summary: Fuko Izumo carries a curse of bad luck that kills anyone she touches. Andy is an immortal man who wants to die. Together they set out on a journey full of battles, strange powers and fate.

dungeon-meshi.summary: After their sister is swallowed by a dragon, Laios and his party head back into the dungeon. Out of money, they decide to survive by cooking the monsters they come across.

classroom-of-the-elite.summary: At Koudo Ikusei School, every student's worth is measured by a ruthless system. Kiyotaka Ayanokouji, a quiet student in Class D, hides a brilliant and manipulative mind in a game between classes.

kimi-ni-todoke.summary: Shy Sawako Kuronuma is nicknamed Sadako because of her looks. When Kazehaya, a popular and warm-hearted boy, starts talking to her, her life changes and she learns to open up to others.

honey-and-clover.summary: A group of art school students share friendship, dreams and unrequited love. Between everyday life, doubts about the future and feelings, they search for their path.

wotakoi.summary: Narumi, a fujoshi otaku who hides her passion at work, reconnects with Hirotaka, a gamer and childhood friend. They decide to date and live their relationship between video games, conventions and awkward moments.

berserk-1997.summary: Guts, a mercenary with a gigantic sword, crosses paths with Griffith, the charismatic leader of the Band of the Hawk. Their shared destiny leads them toward ambition, friendship and a dark tragedy.

monster-anime.summary: Kenzo Tenma, a brilliant neurosurgeon, saves the life of a little boy instead of a local dignitary. Years later, that boy, now grown, turns out to be a merciless killer. Tenma sets out after him across Europe.

black-butler.summary: In Victorian England, young Earl Ciel Phantomhive investigates high society crimes on behalf of the Queen. At his side, his butler Sebastian is a demon bound to him by a contract: he will serve him until Ciel gets his revenge, then devour his soul.

food-wars.summary: Soma Yukihira, son of a small diner owner, enters the elite Totsuki culinary academy, where nine students out of ten get expelled. Through cooking duels called "shokugeki", he tries to stand out among the country's greatest talents.

quintuplets.summary: Futaro Uesugi, a serious but poor student, takes a job as private tutor for five identical sisters with opposite personalities who hate studying. Between lessons, arguments and budding feelings, he has to turn them into good students.

mushishi.summary: In a Japan of no particular era, mushi are primitive beings invisible to most people and the source of illnesses and unexplained phenomena. Ginko travels the country to understand them and help those they affect, in calm, contemplative stories.

dororo.summary: In Japan during the civil wars, a lord offers parts of his firstborn's body to demons to ensure his domain's prosperity. Grown up, the boy, Hyakkimaru, travels the land killing demons to take back each part of his body, accompanied by the young thief Dororo.

to-your-eternity.summary: An immortal orb is sent to Earth and takes the form of a rock, a wolf, then a boy. Named Fushi, he learns to live through the people he meets, sharing their lives, losses and battles across the centuries.

detective-conan.summary: High school detective Shinichi Kudo is turned into a child by a criminal organization. Hiding as Conan Edogawa with the Mouri family, he solves case after case while hoping to one day get his original body back.

initial-d.summary: Takumi Fujiwara delivers tofu for his father's shop on the mountain roads of Akina. Without realizing it, he has developed an extraordinary driving talent, and he is about to take on Japan's best drift teams.

fate-stay-night-ubw.summary: Every sixty years, seven mages summon heroic spirits called Servants to fight in the Holy Grail War. Shirou Emiya and Rin Tohsaka team up in this version, whose ufotable-animated battles are a benchmark.

bungo-stray-dogs.summary: In Yokohama, detectives with powers inspired by famous writers work for the Armed Detective Agency. Atsushi Nakajima, a young orphan kicked out of his home, becomes a member and faces the Port Mafia.

ajin.summary: Ajin are immortal beings who come back to life every time they die. Kei Nagai discovers he is one after an accident and becomes a target hunted by the government, in a thriller as dark as it is tense.

chihayafuru.summary: Chihaya Ayase discovers competitive karuta, a card game based on classical poetry, and starts a club at her high school to reach the top. A touching sports anime about friendship, rivalry and the passage of time.

tower-of-god.summary: Bam follows his friend Rachel into the Tower, a mythical structure where every floor is a deadly test. Anyone who reaches the top gets their wish granted. Adapted from SIU's famous Korean webtoon.

blue-period.summary: Yatora Yaguchi lives a passionless life until the day a painting overwhelms him. He decides to take the entrance exam for the Tokyo University of the Arts, the most selective in Japan.

bakuman.summary: Moritaka Mashiro and Akito Takagi, two high schoolers, dream of getting their manga published in Weekly Shonen Jump. An anime about the tough job of being a manga artist, its rivalries and sacrifices.

dragon-ball.summary: Young Son Goku meets Bulma, who is searching for the seven Dragon Balls that can grant a wish. The beginning of the legend, before the Saiyans and Dragon Ball Z.

ranma.summary: After falling into a cursed spring in China, Ranma Saotome turns into a girl when splashed with cold water. Engaged to Akane, he goes from absurd fights to rivals and misunderstandings.

saint-seiya.summary: Seiya and four other young Bronze Saints protect the goddess Athena with their sacred armor. Knights of the Zodiac, a shonen classic full of mythological battles.

cardcaptor-sakura.summary: Sakura Kinomoto accidentally releases the magic cards of the Clow Book. With the help of Kero and Tomoyo, she must recover them before they spread chaos across town.

fist-of-the-north-star.summary: In a world devastated by nuclear war, Kenshiro, heir to the deadly art of Hokuto Shinken, defends the weak against warlords. A brutal cult classic that left its mark on generations.

gachiakuta.summary: Rudo lives in a poor district where people born on the wrong side are despised. Wrongly accused, he is thrown into the Abyss, a dump full of monsters, where he learns to wield discarded objects as weapons.

natsume-yuujinchou.summary: Takashi Natsume has always been able to see spirits. Inheriting his grandmother's Book of Friends draws yokai to him, and he frees them from their contracts one by one. A gentle, melancholic and comforting series.

oregairu.summary: Hachiman Hikigaya, a loner high schooler with a jaded look, is forced to join the Service Club, where he spends time with Yukino and Yui. A clear-eyed school romance and comedy about relationships.

haruhi-suzumiya.summary: Haruhi Suzumiya, an eccentric high school girl bored with ordinary life, founds the SOS Brigade to find aliens, time travelers and espers. Without knowing it, she shapes reality around her, and her classmate Kyon tries to limit the damage.

railgun.summary: In Academy City, a city of eight million where people develop psychic powers, Mikoto Misaka, one of the seven Level 5 espers, investigates mysterious incidents with her friends. This A Certain Magical Index spin-off mixes action, science fiction and everyday life.

eureka-seven.summary: Fourteen-year-old Renton Thurston dreams of leaving his small town when a mysterious pilot, Eureka, crashes into his garage in a mecha. He joins the Gekkostate crew, and an adventure of sky surfing, romance and planetary secrets begins.

mirai-nikki.summary: Yukiteru Amano, a lonely middle schooler, receives a diary that predicts the future. He becomes a player in a survival game where twelve diary holders fight each other, protected by Yuno Gasai, a classmate whose attachment to him is alarming.

free-iwatobi.summary: Haruka Nanase, who loves water, reunites with his childhood friends at Iwatobi High and starts a swimming club. When Rin returns from Australia, competition, friendship and dreams resurface.

d-gray-man.summary: In a world ravaged by the Millennium Earl, who creates demonic weapons, the exorcists of the Black Order fight with Innocence. Allen Walker, whose left eye sees cursed souls, joins the exorcists to save trapped souls.

aldnoah-zero.summary: After a lunar base is destroyed, Earth is attacked by the Vers, a Martian civilization with overpowered mechas. Inaho Kaizuka, a calm and methodical high schooler, takes on their weapons with his strategic mind.

kabaneri.summary: In a world overrun by Kabane, undead with steel hearts, survivors live in fortresses. Ikoma, a gifted engineer, becomes a Kabaneri, half-human and half-monster, and fights to protect his people alongside Mumei.

guilty-crown.summary: After a virus devastates Tokyo, Shu Ouma, an ordinary high schooler, gains a power that lets him extract other people's Voids. He joins the Funeral Parlor resistance and takes on the GHQ organization.

another.summary: In 1998, Koichi Sakakibara joins class 3-3 at a school in Yomiyama, where students ignore Mei Misaki. A curse has haunted the class for years, and the deaths keep coming.

date-a-live.summary: Shido Itsuka discovers that Spirits, beings from another dimension, cause disasters. To stop them, he must win their hearts and seal their powers, with the help of the Ratatoskr organization.

eden-of-the-east.summary: Akira Takizawa wakes up naked in front of the White House with no memory and a phone holding ten billion yen. With Saki Morimi, a young Japanese woman, he discovers he is one of twelve players in the Selecao game, tasked with "saving Japan".

wolfs-rain.summary: In a frozen world, wolves, believed to be extinct, hide in human form. Kiba and his pack search for Paradise, a legendary land, guided by the flower maiden Cheza.

ergo-proxy.summary: In the domed city of Romdo, androids infected by a virus turn violent. Inspector Re-l Mayer investigates and meets the immigrant Vincent Law, linked to creatures called Proxies, and a philosophical, unsettling journey begins.

welcome-to-the-nhk.summary: Tatsuhiro Sato, a hikikomori shut away for four years, believes in a conspiracy by an organization called the NHK. Meeting Misaki, who wants to "cure" him, shakes up his routine in a dark comedy about loneliness.

re-creators.summary: Sota Mizushino, an animation fan, sees characters from his favorite series burst into the real world. With Altair on the loose, he tries to stop them from starting a war between creators and their creations.

odd-taxi.summary: Hiroshi Odokawa, a walrus taxi driver in a world of anthropomorphic animals, picks up strange passengers. The case of a missing high school girl gradually links all of them in a sharp, dialogue-driven mystery.

vivy.summary: In 2061, Vivy, a singing AI, receives a mission from Matsumoto, an AI from the future: prevent a war between humans and AI by changing history. Over a century, she searches for the meaning of singing and of the heart.

banana-fish.summary: Ash Lynx, a young New York gang leader, investigates the drug "Banana Fish". Meeting Japanese photographer Eiji Okumura changes his life in a thriller about friendship and survival.

link-click.summary: Cheng Xiaoshi and Lu Guang run the Time Photo Studio: by entering a photo, they can relive a moment to help their clients. Their missions confront them with the limits of time.

kekkai-sensen.summary: New York has become Hellsalem's Lot, a place where the human and demonic worlds coexist. Leonardo Watch, whose eyes see everything, joins the Libra organization to protect the city from supernatural threats.

paranoia-agent.summary: In Tokyo, a mysterious teenager with a golden bat and inline skates attacks residents. An investigation mixing crime thriller, social satire and nightmare, by Satoshi Kon.

serial-experiments-lain.summary: Lain, a reserved middle schooler, receives an email from a dead classmate and dives into the Wired, a network where reality and identity blur. A cyberpunk and metaphysical classic.

haibane-renmei.summary: Rakka awakens from a cocoon in the walled town of Glie with a halo and gray wings. She joins the Haibane, mysterious beings, in a gentle, melancholic story about the past and forgiveness.

bakemonogatari.summary: Koyomi Araragi, a high schooler who has become half-vampire, helps girls possessed by apparitions. Sharp dialogue and striking visuals: the starting point of the Monogatari series.

revolutionary-girl-utena.summary: Utena, who dreams of becoming a prince, fights duelists for the hand of Anthy, the Rose Bride. A symbolic fable about power, identity and emancipation.

nodame-cantabile.summary: Chiaki, a perfectionist pianist, meets Nodame, his messy neighbor with incredible talent. Between conservatory, orchestra and romance, a joyful story about classical music.

space-brothers.summary: As kids, Mutta and Hibito dreamed of traveling to space. Hibito becomes an astronaut, and Mutta, after losing his job, tries his luck again. A warm, well-researched story about space exploration.

march-comes-in-like-a-lion.summary: Rei Kiriyama, a shogi prodigy who turned pro at fifteen, lives alone and unhappy. He finds refuge with three sisters. A delicate story about loneliness, depression and rebuilding.

sound-euphonium.summary: Kumiko joins her high school's concert band, which is determined to win the national competition. Between rehearsals, rivalries and emotions, a polished and sincere music anime by Kyoto Animation.

a-silent-voice.summary: Shoya, who bullied Shoko, a deaf classmate, in elementary school, tries to make amends years later. A heartbreaking film about bullying, guilt and forgiveness.

your-name.summary: Mitsuha, a country high school girl, and Taki, a Tokyo high school boy, swap bodies when they wake up. When the link breaks, they try to find each other. The Makoto Shinkai film that captivated the whole world.

weathering-with-you.summary: Hodaka, a teenage runaway in Tokyo, meets Hina, who can make the rain stop. Their gift comes at a price, in a city under an endless downpour. A Makoto Shinkai film.

suzume.summary: Suzume opens a mysterious door in some ruins and unleashes disasters. With a young man turned into a chair, she travels across Japan to close the doors. A Makoto Shinkai film.

the-girl-who-leapt-through-time.summary: Makoto discovers she can leap back in time and uses it for trivial things. The consequences of her time jumps soon catch up with the people around her. A bright summer film by Mamoru Hosoda.

perfect-blue.summary: Mima leaves her pop group to become an actress, but an obsessive fan stalks her as the line between reality and fiction blurs. A cult psychological thriller by Satoshi Kon.

spirited-away.summary: Ten-year-old Chihiro is trapped in a world of spirits where her parents are turned into pigs. To save them, she works in the bathhouse of the witch Yubaba. Studio Ghibli's masterpiece.

princess-mononoke.summary: Cursed, Prince Ashitaka sets out to find a cure and ends up at the heart of the conflict between the humans of Iron Town and the gods of the forest. An ecological epic by Hayao Miyazaki.

howls-moving-castle.summary: Sophie, a young hatmaker, is turned into an old woman by a witch and finds refuge in the moving castle of the wizard Howl. A romantic, poetic tale from Studio Ghibli.

grave-of-the-fireflies.summary: Japan, 1945: Seita and his little sister Setsuko, war orphans, try to survive. A heartbreaking Studio Ghibli film about civilians facing war.

wolf-children.summary: Hana falls in love with a wolf man, then raises their two half-human, half-wolf children alone. A Mamoru Hosoda film about motherhood, being different and independence.

jormungand.summary: Jonah, a former child soldier, joins Koko Hekmatyar, a young arms dealer, and her team of bodyguards. Action, geopolitical intrigue and moral dilemmas around the weapons trade.

terror-in-resonance.summary: Two teenagers, Nine and Twelve, threaten Tokyo with bombings and send riddles to the police. A high school girl, Lisa, gets dragged into their plan. A dark thriller with a soundtrack by Yoko Kanno.

promare.summary: Humans with fire powers, the Burnish, start blazes everywhere. Galo, a hot-headed firefighter, takes on their leader Lio. An explosive, ultra-colorful action film from Studio Trigger.

little-witch-academia.summary: Akko, a fan of the witch Chariot, joins Luna Nova Academy despite her lack of talent. With her friends Lotte and Sucy, she lives magical adventures that are funny and full of energy.

the-eminence-in-shadow.summary: Reincarnated in another world, Cid pretends to be the Eminence in Shadow, leader of a secret organization. Without him knowing, his fantasies are all too real. A hilarious isekai parody.

log-horizon.summary: Thousands of players are trapped in the MMORPG Elder Tale. Shiroe, a strategist, founds the Log Horizon guild and rebuilds a society in this world. More politics and strategy than fighting.

danmachi.summary: Bell Cranel, a young adventurer, joins the goddess Hestia and explores the Dungeon of Orario, hoping to impress the swordswoman Ais. Adventure, comedy and a hero's progression.

megalo-box.summary: Joe, a boxer from the slums, dreams of stepping into the ring of Megalonia, a boxing tournament with exoskeletons. A vibrant tribute to "Ashita no Joe", with a hip-hop soundtrack.

86-eighty-six.summary: The Republic of San Magnolia claims to wage a war without casualties thanks to drones, but the drones are actually piloted by the "86", outcast soldiers. A moving war story about friendship and dignity.

hinamatsuri.summary: Nitta, a yakuza, sees Hina, a girl with psychic powers, appear in his living room. He reluctantly adopts her. A sweet, absurd comedy about family life.

saiki-k.summary: Kusuo Saiki, a high schooler with limitless psychic powers, just wants a quiet life, but his eccentric classmates won't let him have one. A rapid-fire comedy.

nichijou.summary: The daily life of high school girls, a tiny scientist and her robot Nano turns completely delirious. Surreal gags and dazzling animation by Kyoto Animation.

azumanga-daioh.summary: Three years of high school with Chiyo, a ten-year-old prodigy, and her classmates. A slice-of-life comedy that became a benchmark of the genre, funny and endearing.

lucky-star.summary: Konata, a lazy otaku high school girl, spends her days chatting with her friends about everything and nothing. A slice-of-life comedy that became a classic of otaku culture.

prison-school.summary: Five boys, the only male students at a prestigious girls' school, are sent to "prison" after being caught peeping. A very provocative comedy with outrageous humor.

the-devil-is-a-part-timer.summary: The Demon Lord, defeated by the Hero Emilia, ends up in Tokyo without his powers and works at a fast-food restaurant. A light, funny fantasy comedy.

seraph-of-the-end.summary: After a virus kills all the adults, vampires rule humanity. Yuu, an orphan, joins the Moon Demon Company to fight them and find his best friend Mika, who has become a vampire.

kakegurui.summary: In a high school where gambling decides your status, Yumeko Jabami, a ruthless and eccentric gambler, challenges the elite for the thrill of risk. A betting and bluffing anime as excessive as it is addictive.

naruto-shippuden.summary: Two and a half years later, Naruto returns to the Hidden Leaf stronger and faces the Akatsuki, who hunt the tailed beasts. Ninja war, betrayals and a quest to reconcile with Sasuke.

boruto.summary: The new generation of Hidden Leaf ninjas: Boruto, Naruto's son, his teammate Sarada and Mitsuki go on missions and face threats from outer space. The continuation of the Naruto universe.

digimon-adventure.summary: Seven children are pulled into the Digital World, where each one partners with a Digimon. They must face ever more powerful enemies. A childhood classic.

yu-gi-oh-duel-monsters.summary: Yugi completes the Millennium Puzzle and frees the spirit of a game-loving pharaoh. Together they take on game challenges, especially the Duel Monsters card game. A must-watch.

beyblade-metal-fusion.summary: Ginga Hagane, a young blader, discovers the Pegasus top and faces rivals in metal spinning-top battles. A sports series with spectacular duels that is still much loved.

gundam-witch-from-mercury.summary: Suletta, a student from Mercury, joins Asticassia School, where mecha duels settle conflicts. There she meets Miorine, heiress to an empire. A fresh take on the Gundam saga.

gundam-iron-blooded-orphans.summary: Mikazuki, Orga and their companions from the private military company Tekkadan escort young Kudelia, and rise up in revolt. A dark, realistic Gundam centered on child soldiers.

dragon-ball-super.summary: After Buu's defeat, Goku and his friends face gods of destruction and warriors from other universes, including the Tournament of Power. The sequel to Dragon Ball Z.

sket-dance.summary: Three high schoolers found the Sket club, which helps students solve their problems. Between comedy and touching moments, a slice-of-life anime driven by lovable characters.

space-dandy.summary: Dandy, an alien hunter searching for rare species, has wild adventures with the robot QT and the cat Meow. Each episode changes style: a visual comedy by Shinichiro Watanabe.

umineko-no-naku-koro-ni.summary: On a remote island, a family gathers over the patriarch's inheritance while a storm hits. The murders pile up and the witch Beatrice challenges Battler. A dark and baffling mystery.

shiki.summary: In the isolated village of Sotoba, residents die one by one, and the doctors suspect an epidemic... or vampires. A slow-burn psychological horror story about fear and survival.

planetes.summary: In 2075, space debris collectors clean up junk in orbit. Dreamer Hachirota and young recruit Ai want to go further. A realistic and human science fiction story.

knights-of-sidonia.summary: A thousand years after Earth's destruction, humans survive aboard the ship Sidonia, attacked by the Gauna. Nagate, a rookie pilot, becomes a hero. Mecha and sci-fi in 3D animation.

gunslinger-girl.summary: In Italy, a government agency turns sick girls into cyborg assassins, each paired with an agent. A dark, melancholic story about the bond between handlers and victims.

5-centimeters-per-second.summary: Takaki and Akari, separated by a move, try to stay close despite distance and time. Three chapters about childhood love and the passing years. A Makoto Shinkai film.

the-garden-of-words.summary: On rainy mornings, Takao, an aspiring shoemaker, meets Yukino, a mysterious woman, in a park. A short Makoto Shinkai film of rare painterly beauty.

toilet-bound-hanako-kun.summary: Nene summons Hanako, the ghost of the school toilets, to grant her love wish and becomes his assistant in investigating the school's mysteries. A mix of comedy, the supernatural and emotion.

iruma-kun.summary: Iruma, sold by his parents to a demon, is adopted and enrolled in a school for demons, where he must hide that he is human. A cheerful fantasy comedy.

zom-100.summary: Akira, an exhausted office worker, is thrilled by the zombie apocalypse: finally free! He writes a list of a hundred things to do before he dies. A quirky horror comedy bursting with life.

shangri-la-frontier.summary: Rakuro, a hunter of "trash games", dives into Shangri-La Frontier, a cult virtual reality game. As his avatar Sunraku, he takes on legendary bosses. A spectacular video game shonen.

the-dangers-in-my-heart.summary: Kyotaro, a withdrawn high schooler, secretly fantasizes about Anna, the most popular girl in class, but discovers she isn't who he thought. A sincere and touching school romance.

skip-and-loafer.summary: Mitsumi, a brilliant girl from the countryside who has just arrived in Tokyo, adjusts to her new high school with Sosuke and their friends. A sincere romantic comedy about shyness, courage and friendship.

blue-box-anime.summary: Taiki, a badminton player, is in love with Chinatsu, a basketball star. When she moves into his house, their routines and dreams intertwine. A hopeful sports romance.

wind-breaker-anime.summary: Haruka Sakura, a brawler high schooler, arrives at Furin High, run by students who protect the town. Between fights and a new family, he learns what defending your own really means.

violet-evergarden-movie.summary: Violet, an Auto Memory Doll, keeps writing letters. Meeting a child leads her to a truth about Gilbert. The series' gentle concluding film.

bleach-tybw.summary: The Quincy, led by Yhwach, attack the Soul Society. Ichigo returns to face the greatest war in its history. Bleach's final arc, with superb animation.

lupin-iii-part-3.summary: Gentleman thief Lupin III and his accomplices Jigen, Goemon and Fujiko pull off heist after heist, chased by Inspector Zenigata. A classic of 80s adventure and humor.

my-neighbor-totoro.summary: Two sisters, Satsuki and Mei, move to the countryside and meet the spirits of the forest, including the giant Totoro. A tender Miyazaki film that became a worldwide icon.

castle-in-the-sky.summary: Sheeta, a girl with a magic pendant, and Pazu, a young miner, search for the flying city of Laputa, chased by pirates and the army. A great adventure film by Hayao Miyazaki.

nausicaa-of-the-valley-of-the-wind.summary: On an Earth ravaged by a toxic forest, Princess Nausicaa tries to make humans and giant insects live together. An ecological and poetic film by Miyazaki.

cells-at-work.summary: Inside the human body, a clumsy red blood cell and a fighting white blood cell protect the body from viruses and bacteria. A funny, colorful educational anime about biology.

slayers.summary: Lina Inverse, a formidable sorceress, travels with the swordsman Gourry. Along the way they meet new allies and ancient powers. A classic comedic fantasy adventure.

one-piece-film-red.summary: The Straw Hats attend a concert by Uta, a singer adored all over the world and Shanks' daughter. But behind her voice, a secret changes everything. A One Piece musical film.

detective-conan-time-bombed-skyscraper.summary: Conan, the shrunken detective, must defuse bombs hidden in a skyscraper to save his friends. The first film of the Detective Conan saga.

cyberpunk-edgerunners-2.summary: Back to Night City for a brand-new ten-episode season. Weak, a washed-up edgerunner legend living without his chrome, searches for a new purpose, while D, a deadly nomad, follows a path of revenge that leads him toward closely guarded corpo secrets. A story of family, obsession and legacy.

cdesc.D: A Snake Nation netrunner hunting the killer who wiped out his clan.
cdesc.Roman Carax: A young film buff trying to capture Night City's real stories.
cdesc.Weak Kingsley: A former top edgerunner once called "King", now living in the shadow of his past glory.

the-apothecary-diaries-season-3.summary: After the Shi clan's rebellion, Maomao is back to her life as an apothecary in the pleasure district. A simple breakfast raises her suspicions and sends her on a new investigation, while Jinshi, now revealed as the Emperor's brother, worries over Loulan's final warning: a disaster is about to strike the nation.

cdesc.Maomao: A curious, blunt apothecary fascinated by poisons and remedies.
cdesc.Jinshi: The Emperor's dazzlingly handsome brother, who relies on Maomao's sharp mind.

black-clover-season-2.summary: As tyranny engulfs the Clover Kingdom, Asta and the Magic Knights launch a desperate raid on the Spade Kingdom to rescue their captains from the Dark Triad. A battle unlike any before awaits them, and Asta must push past his limits to keep the promise he made to Yuno.

cdesc.Asta: An orphan born without magic who wields anti-magic and dreams of becoming Wizard King.
cdesc.Yuno: Asta's childhood friend and rival, a gifted mage with a four-leaf grimoire.

overgeared.summary: Sin Yeong-U, a.k.a. Grid, an unlucky player of the VR game "Satisfy", finds an item that grants him a legendary class: Pagma's Successor. Now a blacksmith able to forge the most powerful gear, he chases fame and fortune, but his very existence starts to shake up the whole game.

cdesc.Yeong-U Sin: A debt-ridden, unlucky player who becomes the legendary blacksmith Grid.

reincarnated-as-a-sword-season-2.summary: Season two of the adventures of Fran, a young cat-girl, and Master, the intelligent sword who travels with her and protects her like a father. Their life as adventurers leads to new battles and fearsome enemies, including a necromancer who can raise armies of the dead.

cdesc.Fran: A stoic young cat-girl, fearsome in battle and determined to help her race evolve.
cdesc.Shishou: A soul reincarnated as a sword, watching over Fran like a father.

firefly-wedding.summary: Satoko seems to have it all: beautiful, a nobleman's daughter, at the perfect age to marry. But she is seriously ill and has little time left. When the mysterious assassin Shinpei targets her, she makes a desperate move: she proposes marriage. A dark romance that takes "till death do us part" very seriously.

cdesc.Satoko Kirigaya: A young noblewoman with a heart condition who wants to marry before it's too late.
cdesc.Shinpei Gotou: The enigmatic assassin who was supposed to kill Satoko.

even-the-student-council-has-its-holes.summary: At Fujinasu Academy, Ume Mizunoe, great at literature but hopeless at science, joins the student council to avoid repeating a year. There he meets a lovable and bizarre crew, from a charismatic president to a scary but kind treasurer. A wacky, sometimes risqué romantic comedy.

cdesc.Ume Mizunoe: A literary prize winner who is terrible at science, the council's new secretary.
cdesc.Hisako Kotobuki: The student council president, top of the school and admired by all.

blue-box-season-2.summary: The sequel to Blue Box. Taiki and Chinatsu's feelings keep growing, but a broken friendship from the past and fierce competition complicate their road to nationals.

cdesc.Chinatsu Kano: The rising star of the basketball team, who lives at Taiki's house.
cdesc.Taiki Inomata: A hard-working badminton player in love with Chinatsu.

jojo-steel-ball-run-2nd-3rd-stage.summary: The Steel Ball Run race continues. Johnny Joestar and Gyro Zeppeli must cross a 750-mile desert known as the "Devil's Palm", where a mysterious threat once wiped out an entire cavalry. They soon realize this race hides far more than a simple competition.

cdesc.Gyro Zeppeli: A flamboyant Neapolitan executioner and master of the steel balls.
cdesc.Johnny Joestar: A former jockey left paraplegic, with unshakable determination.

the-laid-off-cheat-granting-mage-enjoys-.summary: Rein, an enchanter, is kicked out of his guild. Instead of despairing, he takes back all the enhancement points he gave his former comrades and starts over as an adventurer. A team of people scarred by life gathers around him, in an original fantasy world where magic, guns and yakuza coexist.

cdesc.Rain Garland: An enchanter kicked out of his guild, warm-hearted and holding no grudges.

the-ramparts-of-ice-season-2.summary: Lonely Koyuki, former school idol Miki, personal-space-ignoring Minato and gentle basketball player Youta: the sequel to this ensemble coming-of-age story. Koyuki and Minato grow closer, Youta finally confesses to Miki, and their hearts keep crossing paths.

cdesc.Koyuki Hikawa: A high school girl hurt by her past, hiding behind walls of ice.
cdesc.Minato Amamiya: A cheerful, pushy boy determined to become Koyuki's friend.

tokyo-revengers-war-of-the-three-titans-.summary: The sequel to Tokyo Revengers' Tenjiku arc. Takemichi must once again travel back in time to save the people he loves, as a war between three giant gangs threatens to change everything.

cdesc.Takemichi Hanagaki: A young man who travels back in time to save the people he loves.

a-returner-s-magic-should-be-special-sea.summary: In a world ravaged by the Shadow Worlds, six heroes try to save humanity... and fail. Desir, one of the last mages, suddenly wakes up thirteen years in the past. Armed with his knowledge of the future, he trains his allies at the academy to change the course of history. Season two.

cdesc.Desir Herrman: A mage sent back in time, determined to make his allies stronger.

hello-i-am-a-witch-and-my-crush-wants-me.summary: "Make me a love potion." With that one sentence, Rose, the Good Witch of the Lake, sees her secret crush on the knight Harij end in heartbreak. But when he offers to help gather the ingredients, she jumps at the chance to spend time with him, and he starts showing up at her door with bread and apple butter. A sweet, funny romance.

cdesc.Rose: A witch skilled at elixirs, secretly in love with Harij.
cdesc.Hariju Azumu: An elite knight of the royal palace who comes to order a love potion.

dragon-ball-super-beerus.summary: A few years after the battle against Majin Buu, Earth finally enjoys peace. But Beerus, the God of Destruction, wakes from a long sleep and hears of a Saiyan who defeated Frieza. A reworked edition of Dragon Ball Super, with many redrawn scenes and closer to Akira Toriyama's manga.

cdesc.Gokuu Son: A big-hearted Saiyan always looking for stronger opponents.
cdesc.Beerus: A moody God of Destruction who loves sleeping and good food.

reborn-as-a-space-mercenary-i-woke-up-pi.summary: Sato Takahiro, an ordinary office worker and gamer, wakes up at the controls of a ship that looks exactly like the one from his favorite space shooter. With an overpowered ship, a charming crew and an entire universe to explore, he plans to live the mercenary life he always dreamed of.

cdesc.Takahiro Sato: A former office worker who becomes captain of the ship Krishna.

nia-liston-the-merciless-maiden.summary: A great hero dies undefeated in her bed, regretting she never found a worthy opponent. She wakes up in the body of Nia Liston, a sickly young noble girl. This time, she intends to devote her second life to battle: make way for the Merciless Maiden!

cdesc.Nia Liston: A young noble girl inhabited by the soul of a legendary warrior.

as-a-reincarnated-aristocrat-i-ll-use-my.summary: Season three of the adventures of Ars Louvent, reincarnated as a noble's son with the gift of appraising anyone's talent. He keeps recruiting exceptional people to grow his domain in a country at war.

cdesc.Ars Louvent: A reincarnated young noble who can see people's hidden talents.

i-m-dating-a-dark-summoner.summary: Amona, a summoner with demonic powers, and Roni, a far too uptight priest, should hate each other. Instead, one night together turns into a habit they must hide from the rest of their adventuring party, with an imp far too interested in their love life. A risqué romantic comedy.

cdesc.Roni Gardihaus: A devout, uptight priest who collects wine.

aoashi-season-2.summary: Ashito Aoi has finally earned his spot on the A team, but reality is harsh. Surrounded by elite players like Kuribayashi and Akutsu, practices are as merciless as the matches. In the U-18 Premier League, he must evolve or be crushed.

magic-repo-man-dumped-by-my-party-ill-ca.summary: Lent lends his magic to his teammates thanks to a unique gift. But once they become heroes thanks to him, they call him useless and kick him out. Furious, he discovers a hidden side to his power: with a cute but cunning fairy, he's going to take back all the magic he lent... with interest!

cdesc.Lent: A magic lender kicked out of his party, ready to take it all back.

magical-explorer.summary: A fan of adult Japanese video games wakes up in the world of Magical Explorer... but in the body of Kousuke Takioto, the hero's dorky best friend. With his perfect knowledge of the game and Kousuke's strange powers, he plans to turn this loser into the strongest character. A risqué fantasy comedy.

cdesc.Kousuke Takioto: The game hero's best friend, inhabited by a player who knows everything.

the-detective-is-already-dead-season-2.summary: After foiling a hijacking with Siesta, a silver-haired detective, Kimihiko traveled the world solving cases... until Siesta died. A year later, a new case reopens old wounds. Season two.

cdesc.Kimihiko Kimizuka: Siesta's former assistant and a magnet for trouble.
cdesc.Siesta: A great detective with a musket, Kimihiko's late partner.

fool-night.summary: In the distant future, the sun has vanished behind thick clouds and oxygen is scarce. To survive, humanity turns people into plants. Toshiro Kamiya, poor and with a sick mother, considers giving up his body for money. A dark, unsettling sci-fi thriller.

cdesc.Toshirou Kamiya: A poor young man who hears the voices of flowers after his transfloration.
cdesc.Yomiko Hourai: Toshiro's childhood friend, who works at the transfloration center.

a-wild-last-boss-appeared-season-2.summary: Season two. Lufas Maphaahl, the fearsome "Black-Winged Overlord" sealed away after her defeat by the Seven Heroes, returns to a world that moved on without her for two hundred years. She sets out to find her former servants, the Twelve Heavenly Stars.

cdesc.Lufas Maphaahl: A legendary level-1000 overlord, back two centuries after being sealed.
cdesc.Dina: A loyal retainer who waited two hundred years for Lufas to return.

psyren.summary: High schooler Ageha Yoshina picks up a mysterious "red phone card" in a phone booth. A few days later, his childhood friend Sakurako, who had the same card, vanishes. Searching for her, he discovers the secret organization "Psyren" and is thrown into a deadly game. An adaptation of Toshiaki Iwashiro's cult manga.

cdesc.Ageha Yoshina: An impulsive but clear-headed high schooler dragged into the Psyren game.
cdesc.Sakurako Amamiya: Ageha's childhood friend, now cold and mysterious.

full-clearing-another-world-under-a-godd.summary: RPG player Makoto Takatsuki is thrown into another world with terrible skills and stats. He then meets Noah, a goddess with no believers at all, who offers him her blessings if he becomes her first follower.

cdesc.Makoto Takatsuki: A player with poor stats who becomes the goddess Noah's first believer.

the-cold-sato-san-is-only-sweet-to-me.summary: Sato-san is the class's unattainable girl, cold to everyone. Oshio-kun is cheerful and runs his family café's social media. Each discovers a side of the other that nobody else knows. A sweet high school romance about first love.

cdesc.Koharu Satou: A high school girl known for being icy, whose smile is only for Oshio.
cdesc.Souta Oshio: A smiling high schooler who runs his father's café account.

so-what-s-wrong-with-getting-reborn-as-a.summary: Akira Yagami, an office worker who is too nice for his own good, dies saving a child and is reborn... as a goblin! Goblins normally live only seven days, but his new powers let him defy that rule and aim to become the strongest goblin of all time.

cdesc.Akira: A former office worker reborn as a goblin with extraordinary powers.

the-iceblade-sorcerer-shall-rule-the-wor.summary: Ray White, the only "ordinary" student at the prestigious Arnold Academy, is secretly the Iceblade Sorcerer. In his new school year, he takes part in the Magicks War, a competition between rival schools, while the other grand sorcerers plot in the shadows. Season two.

cdesc.Ray White: A low-key student hiding his identity as the Iceblade Sorcerer.

the-world-s-strongest-witch.summary: After crushing her former family's ambitions with her SSS-rank skill, "Internet", Lorna travels freely. She arrives in Aquas, a port town where she hoped to sightsee and eat seafood, but the town is threatened by a mysterious weekly quest. Luckily, the gods are on her side.

cdesc.Rona Hermit: A noble's daughter banished for a so-called useless skill, now the strongest witch.

tougen-anki-nikko-kegon-falls-arc.summary: After the battles in Kyoto and Nerima, the Rasetsu Academy students have grown stronger. But Yaoroshi leaves to join an oni brigade bent on wiping out every Momotaro, civilians included. Shiki sets out to bring him back, while in Nikko, a lab carries out horrific experiments above Kegon Falls.

cdesc.Shiki Ichinose: An oni with fire in his blood, awakened after his adoptive father's death.

a-tale-of-the-secret-saint.summary: Fia dreams of becoming a knight, but she is the least talented in her family. Facing a dragon during her trial, she nearly dies and remembers her past life: she was a great Saint who defeated the Demon King. Fearing that painful past, she hides her powers while becoming stronger than ever.

cdesc.Fia Ruud: A young knight hiding that she is the reincarnation of a great Saint.
cdesc.Zavilia: A black dragon who becomes Fia's familiar.

romelia-war-chronicle.summary: Romelia and her companions defeat the Demon King Zelgis, but Prince Henri calls her "dead weight" and breaks off their engagement. Rejected by her family and society, Romelia refuses to give up: she already has a plan, and builds her own army to protect humanity.

cdesc.Romélia von Graham: A noble strategist cast aside after victory, who raises her own army.

fx-fighter-kurumi-chan.summary: Kurumi, a university student, finally starts foreign exchange (FX) trading to win back the 20 million yen her mother lost. She thought it would be easy, but the market can swing from heaven to hell in an instant. With fellow trading addicts, she rides joy and despair in a comedy about a risky money game.

cdesc.Kurumi Fukuga: An analytical student who loses her cool when the market goes wild.

ranma1-2-2024-season-3.summary: Season three of the Ranma ½ remake. More rivals and misadventures for Ranma and Akane: Cologne trains Ryoga, a cookie war gets out of hand and Shampoo hatches new schemes.

cdesc.Ranma Saotome: A martial artist who turns into a girl when splashed with cold water.
cdesc.Akane Tendou: Ranma's fiancée, with an explosive temper and a fearsome mallet.

the-vermilion-mask.summary: The masks of the legendary craftsman Gaston Roux grant immense power to whoever wears them, for better or worse. Possessed by the "Mask of the Warrior God", his apprentice Peru unwittingly kills his friends and his own master. To atone, he swears to destroy every one of Gaston's masks scattered across the world.

cdesc.Peru D'Arrest: An apprentice mask maker on a quest for redemption.

a-certain-dark-item.summary: On the dark side of Academy City, ITEM is an elite unit of four girls carrying out secret missions: Mugino, a Level 5 esper, Takitsubo, who tracks other people's powers, Frenda, an explosives expert, and Kinuhata, who controls nitrogen. A story of friendship and darkness, spun off from A Certain Magical Index.

cdesc.Shizuri Mugino: A Level 5 esper with the destructive "Meltdowner" power, leader of ITEM.
cdesc.Frenda Seivelun: A powerless ITEM member who fights with traps and explosives.

chitose-is-in-the-ramune-bottle-2nd-cour.summary: The continuation of Chitose Is in the Ramune Bottle. Saku Chitose, the most popular boy at Fuji High, keeps helping his classmates with their problems, between complicated friendships and feelings that are harder and harder to ignore.

cdesc.Saku Chitose: A popular, charming high schooler at the center of his circle of friends.

sasaki-and-peeps-season-2.summary: Season two. Sasaki, a fifty-something office worker, lives a double life: he trades with a fantasy world thanks to Peeps, his bird who is actually a great sage, while getting tangled up in the affairs of espers in our world.

cdesc.Sasaki: A quiet office worker caught up in several worlds at once.
cdesc.Piercarlo: A great sage reincarnated as a sparrow, nicknamed Peeps.

even-though-i-m-a-super-timid-noble-girl.summary: At ten, Pia Rockwell remembers her past life as a paleontology student and realizes she is the villainess of a romance video game. Terrified of being exiled, she asks to break off her engagement to Rufus, the Prime Minister's son, so she can live as a commoner and dig up fossils. But her cunning fiancé has no intention of letting her go.

cdesc.Pia Rockwell: A very timid young noble passionate about fossils.
cdesc.Rufus Stan: Pia's cunning fiancé, the Prime Minister's son.

magic-knight-rayearth-2026.summary: A new adaptation of the CLAMP classic. During a school trip to Tokyo Tower, Hikaru, Umi and Fuu are summoned by Princess Emeraude to the world of Cephiro. They must become the Magic Knights to save it.

cdesc.Hikaru Shidou: The Magic Knight of Fire, small but full of energy.
cdesc.Umi Ryuuzaki: The Magic Knight of Water, elegant and quick-tempered.

i-m-looking-for-a-zombie.summary: The city is in ruins and overrun with zombies, but to Aki and her friends, it's amazing! Raised in a small village on stories of the old world, she sets off with her childhood friends to find her missing father. A survival adventure as funny as it is creepy.

cdesc.Aki: A girl searching for her father, fierce in a fight but afraid of heights.

devils-crest.summary: Sixth-grader Yuuma and his twin sister Sawa are playing Actual Magic, a new VR MMORPG, when the game suddenly merges with the real world. Death lurks everywhere, and a classmate has turned into a monster. From the author of Sword Art Online.

cdesc.Yuuma Ashihara: An 11-year-old schoolboy and seasoned MMO player.
cdesc.Sawa Ashihara: Yuuma's twin sister and a hardcore gamer.

mission-yozakura-family-season-2-part-2.summary: The continuation of Mission: Yozakura Family season two. Taiyo, married to Mutsumi, head of the Yozakura spy family, keeps training to protect her from ever more dangerous threats.

cdesc.Taiyou Asano: A high schooler who became a spy to protect his wife Mutsumi.
cdesc.Mutsumi Yozakura: Head of the Yozakura family and Taiyo's wife.

tank-chair.summary: Nagi, a fearsome assassin, took a bullet to protect his sister Shizuka and has been comatose in a wheelchair ever since. But Shizuka has found a way to wake him up: confront him with killing intent. So she takes on the most dangerous jobs for him, in a journey as violent as it is spectacular.

cdesc.Nagi Taira: A comatose assassin who wakes up when he senses murderous intent.
cdesc.Shizuka Taira: Nagi's guilt-ridden sister, who steers him into battle.

suikoden.summary: Childhood friends Riou and Jowy have always fought side by side, dreaming of a future away from the battlefield. When war engulfs the Highland Kingdom, they are swept into a conflict far greater than themselves. As the 108 Stars of Destiny gather, their friendship is put to the test. An adaptation of Suikoden II.

cdesc.Riou: An adopted orphan drawn into war with his best friend Jowy.
cdesc.Jowy Atreides: Riou's best friend, from an aristocratic family that mistreats him.

magical-girl-raising-project-restart.summary: Chosen by the mysterious Land of Magic, magical girls each receive a unique power. Pechka, whose magic makes food delicious, is forced into a virtual game with sixteen other magical girls. It was supposed to be safe training... it's the start of an orchestrated nightmare. A dark thriller.

cdesc.Kanoe Hitokouji: The calculating leader of Team Pfle, willing to manipulate to win.

the-seven-knights-of-the-marronnier-king.summary: At the heart of a continent of eight kingdoms, General Baribara of the Marronnier Kingdom has seven sons, each with a unique gift and a knight commander. United by the dream of one day rescuing a princess, the brothers set out as ambassadors to the seven neighboring kingdoms.

cdesc.Harapeko: The seventh and youngest brother, cute but strong and a big eater.
cdesc.Kemonotsukai: The fifth brother, who can talk to and command animals.

super-psychic-policeman-chojo.summary: An explosive police duo! Nao, a rookie with a judo black belt nicknamed "Gorilla", is paired with Chojo, a cop with every psychic power imaginable... who still can't read the room. Together they fight crime in Chinjuku. A quirky police comedy.

cdesc.Meguru Choujou: A psychic police officer, as gifted as he is clueless.
cdesc.Nao Ippongi: A rookie judo expert with superhuman strength.

horror-collector.summary: Urban legends are coming to life all over Japan since a faceless child appeared. If you meet one, pray the boy in the red hood finds you in time. An episodic horror series about urban legends.

cdesc.Fushigi Senno: A mysterious boy in a red hood who collects urban legends.
cdesc.Himitsu Senno: Fushigi's twin sister, who creates the urban legends.

from-far-away.summary: On her way home from school, Noriko is thrown into a strange fantasy world. She is rescued by Izark, a brave swordsman... who harbors the darkest evil within him. According to a prophecy, Noriko has the power to unleash that evil. Bound together, they must cross a world as wondrous as it is hostile. An adaptation of Kyoko Hikawa's cult shojo.

cdesc.Izark Kia Tarj: A wandering swordsman, the reincarnation of the Sky Demon.
cdesc.Noriko Tachiki: An ordinary high school girl, the "Awakening" of the prophecy.

uncle-s-obsession-with-cute-things.summary: By day, Mitsutaka Oji is the handsome, dependable boss everyone admires. By night, he dotes on his favorite mascot, Pugtaro, and indulges his secret love of all things cute. But an unexpected encounter threatens to blow his double life wide open. A sweet comedy.

cdesc.Mitsutaka Oji: A handsome section manager and secret fan of the mascot Pugtaro.

vertex-force.summary: Akira lives peacefully in Okinawa with his sister Haruka and his mother, who runs a café. But the family hides a secret: Haruka inherited a power called "Engine" from their father. Akira didn't, and it eats at him. Meanwhile, strange events break out around the world. An original mecha series.

cdesc.Akira Toudou: A middle schooler with a strong sense of justice, insecure about having no power.
cdesc.Haruka Toudou: Akira's cheerful, athletic sister, heir to the "Engine" power.

ace-of-the-diamond-act-ii-second-season.summary: The sequel to Ace of the Diamond act II. Eijun Sawamura and the Seido High baseball team keep fighting their way to Koshien, with ever fiercer rivalries.

cdesc.Eijun Sawamura: A fiery left-handed pitcher from Nagano.
cdesc.Kazuya Miyuki: Seido's brilliant catcher and team captain.

welsh-shedar.summary: Welsh, a country boy who loves to cook, and Shedar, a young prince destined to rule, cross paths by chance. Together they must stop a cruel tyrant from conquering the world. A fantasy adventure set in the Dofus universe.
