cdesc.Welsh: A cheerful boy and gifted cook from Broccoli Village.
cdesc.Shedar: The brilliant, level-headed prince of the Kingdom of Bonta.

tetsuryo-meet-with-tetsudou-musume.summary: Misaki often dreams of leaving everything behind to travel far away. At university, she meets the Railway Travel Research Club, the "Tetsuryo Club". As her world unfolds along the railway lines, her heart starts racing. A gentle series for Tetsudou Musume's 20th anniversary.

cdesc.Misaki Sata: A first-year student new to trains, searching for a passion.

girls-und-panzer-motto-love-love-sakusen.summary: The daily lives of the Ooarai girls and the other schools devoted to the way of the tank, in a slice-of-life comedy spin-off of Girls und Panzer.

cdesc.Miho Nishizumi: Commander of Ooarai's tank team, from a renowned family.

hotel-inhumans-season-2.summary: Season two. At Hotel Inhumans, a hotel for assassins only, Ikuro, a concierge who hates violence, and Sara, his cold and formidable colleague, keep catering to the requests of very unusual guests.

cdesc.Ikurou Hoshi: A concierge who hates blood, lost in a hotel for assassins.
cdesc.Sara Haizaki: A veteran concierge, calm, ruthless and fearsome in a fight.

dandivine.summary: Twenty years after the robot Dandivine defeated the mysterious Aposdoll, the world is at peace, and the toy maker Kasuga, which lived off its merchandise, is in decline. Its president prays for Dandivine's return... and the Aposdoll come back. High schooler Gekiha is invited to pilot the giant robot.

cdesc.Gekiha Shijima: A high schooler invited to pilot the giant robot Dandivine.

dark-machine-the-animation.summary: Following his grandfather's last wish to "seek out the Senki", Kairi travels to Golden Valley, a special economic zone built around Dark Machines. There he meets Rudra, a mysterious girl who drags him into becoming a pilot, and his talent blossoms through intense battles.

cdesc.Kairi: A young man following his grandfather's last wish.

umayuru-full-gate.summary: A series of short episodes featuring pint-sized Uma Musume. This time, it's a three-minute race where all the Uma Musume hit the track together, in a laid-back, funny atmosphere.

cdesc.Special Week: A pure-hearted runner from Hokkaido, full of dreams.

with-vengeance-sincerely-your-broken-sai.summary: Season two. Lua, a betrayed and scarred saint who was sentenced to death before going back in time, continues her revenge against those who betrayed her, alongside Prince Sven.

cdesc.Lua: A betrayed, scarred saint who went back in time for revenge.

battle-spirits-re-zekkai-no-ku.summary: Japan, at the end of the Edo period. Young Kuu Bashin dreams of growing stronger through Battle Spirits. His life changes when he meets Zetsu Ajara, a wandering samurai and formidable battler hunted by anti-shogunate forces. A new series from the Battle Spirits card game franchise.

cdesc.Ku Bashin: A young boy who dreams of growing strong through Battle Spirits.
cdesc.Zetsu Ajara: A wandering samurai and formidable battler.

keroro.summary: Sergeant Keroro, an alien frog, comes to conquer Earth... but gets captured and ends up living with the Hinata family. The cult comedy returns in a new series.

cdesc.Keroro: An alien sergeant sent to invade Earth, and a model-kit fanatic.
cdesc.Fuyuki Hinata: The Hinata family's son, a fan of the supernatural and Keroro's friend.

the-prince-of-tennis-ii-u-17-world-cup-f.summary: Old rivalries reignite as Team Japan's players face off to earn their spots in the U-17 World Cup final.

cdesc.Ryoma Echizen: A young tennis prodigy with extraordinary talent.

magical-sisters-luluttolilly-part-2.summary: The second half of Magical Sisters LuluttoLilly. Sisters Fuu and Rui transform into idol magical girls and continue their adventures in song.

cdesc.Fuu Nonoyama: A cheerful, spontaneous schoolgirl, always the center of attention.
cdesc.Rui Nonoyama: Her serious, quiet big sister, who used to love singing.

berserk.summary: A lone mercenary carries a huge sword and a consuming hatred for his former friend, responsible for a sacrifice that destroyed his life. He travels through a dark medieval world haunted by demons, on an endless quest for revenge.
berserk.author: Kentaro Miura

vagabond.summary: Inspired by the life of the famous swordsman Musashi Miyamoto, this manga follows his journey from a violent, lost young man to the search for a true way of the sword, through duels and life-changing encounters.
vagabond.author: Takehiko Inoue

vinland-saga-manga.summary: The original work behind the anime of the same name, taking the story of young Viking Thorfinn much further in his quest for revenge and then redemption, with even greater historical and philosophical depth.
vinland-saga-manga.author: Makoto Yukimura

chainsaw-man-manga.summary: The original Chainsaw Man, with its author's signature dark humor and graphic violence, follows Denji into a second part that explores new characters and a more introspective plot.
chainsaw-man-manga.author: Tatsuki Fujimoto

jjk-manga.summary: The complete original Jujutsu Kaisen, including the entire final arc not yet covered by the anime when it aired, where the stakes and losses reach a huge scale.
jjk-manga.author: Gege Akutami

one-punch-man.summary: A hero who has become so strong he beats any opponent with a single punch is bored to death for lack of a real challenge. This manga twists superhero tropes with absurd humor and spectacular fights.
one-punch-man.author: ONE (story), Yusuke Murata (art)

tokyo-ghoul.summary: An ordinary student is turned into a half-human, half-ghoul after a near-fatal encounter, forcing him to navigate a hidden world where ghouls feed on humans while fighting to keep his humanity.
tokyo-ghoul.author: Sui Ishida

monster.summary: A brilliant surgeon sees his career ruined after choosing to save a child's life rather than a mayor's. Years later, he discovers the child has become a manipulative serial killer, and sets out after him.
monster.author: Naoki Urasawa

fma-manga.summary: The original work following the Elric brothers in their search for the Philosopher's Stone, the basis of the faithful Brotherhood anime, with an ending planned by the author from the start.
fma-manga.author: Hiromu Arakawa

slam-dunk.summary: A hot-headed high schooler joins his school's basketball team to impress a girl and, despite himself, discovers a real passion for the sport. This sports manga classic follows his technical and personal growth within a close-knit team.
slam-dunk.author: Takehiko Inoue

uzumaki.summary: A small coastal town slowly sinks into a curse obsessed with the shape of the spiral, which infects bodies, minds and even the town's architecture. A masterpiece of psychological and body horror by Junji Ito.
uzumaki.author: Junji Ito

golden-kamuy.summary: In early 20th-century Hokkaido, a hardened war veteran teams up with a young Ainu girl to find a hidden gold treasure whose location is tattooed on the skin of escaped prisoners, in a treasure hunt as brutal as it is historical.
golden-kamuy.author: Satoru Noda

20th-century-boys.summary: A group of childhood friends discovers that the imaginary global conspiracy game they invented as kids is coming true exactly as planned, orchestrated by a mysterious masked leader. An ensemble thriller spanning several decades.
20th-century-boys.author: Naoki Urasawa

akira.summary: In a cyberpunk Neo-Tokyo ravaged by gangs, a young biker watches his best friend develop uncontrollable psychic powers linked to a secret government experiment. A founding work of modern Japanese science fiction.
akira.author: Katsuhiro Otomo

pluto.summary: A robot detective investigates a series of murders targeting the world's most advanced robots, each killed in a way strangely evoking devil's horns. A dark, philosophical reinterpretation of a manga classic.
pluto.author: Naoki Urasawa

blue-lock.summary: After a painful World Cup defeat, the Japanese football federation locks three hundred promising strikers inside a ruthless training center, where only one will survive to become the selfish goal scorer the national team needs.
blue-lock.author: Muneyuki Kaneshiro

jojo-manga.summary: The original work following several generations of the Joestar family across the world and through the ages, fighting supernatural forces with spiritual manifestations called Stands. A cult saga instantly recognizable for its flamboyant visual style.
jojo-manga.author: Hirohiko Araki

made-in-abyss-manga.summary: The original work following the exploration of a gigantic chasm full of treasures and unspeakable horrors, with a deceptively childlike art style hiding a fearsomely dark story.
made-in-abyss-manga.author: Akihito Tsukushi

kingdom.summary: In ancient China, torn apart by wars between rival kingdoms, a young orphan who dreams of becoming the greatest general in history rises through the military ranks alongside a young king determined to unify the land.
kingdom.author: Yasuhisa Hara

dorohedoro.summary: In a grimy city where sorcerers come to practice by experimenting on the residents, an amnesiac man with a lizard head hunts the one who took his memory, armed with unshakable rage and biting dark humor.
dorohedoro.author: Q Hayashida

frieren.summary: After the death of her hero companions who defeated the Demon King, a near-immortal elf mage realizes too late how little she knew about them, having shared so little time on their human scale. She sets off on a new journey to better understand the short lives around her.
frieren.author: Kanehito Yamada

beastars.summary: In a high school where anthropomorphic herbivores and carnivores barely manage to coexist, a shy wolf fights his predatory instincts while falling in love with a fragile rabbit, amid an investigation into a murder at the school.
beastars.author: Paru Itagaki

gto.summary: A former biker delinquent with the unlikely dream of becoming the best teacher in Japan lands a job at a tough school. His unorthodox methods shake up students and the institution alike, but hide a real will to save the kids everyone gave up on.
gto.author: Tooru Fujisawa

yotsuba.summary: The light, heartwarming daily life of a little girl with boundless energy and endless curiosity, who discovers every little thing in life, from ice cream to fireworks, with contagious wonder, alongside her adoptive father and their neighbors.
yotsuba.author: Kiyohiko Azuma

oshi-no-ko-manga.summary: The original work following a gynecologist reborn as the son of an idol after his death, revealing from the inside the ruthless and sometimes criminal backstage of the Japanese entertainment industry.
oshi-no-ko-manga.author: Aka Akasaka

dandadan-manga.summary: The original work following a high school girl who believes in ghosts and a classmate who believes in aliens, swept into an adventure proving both are real, between unbridled action and comedy.
dandadan-manga.author: Yukinobu Tatsu

hells-paradise-manga.summary: The original work following a condemned ninja exploring a mysterious island in search of an elixir of immortality, alongside other criminals and their executioners, facing terrifying supernatural creatures.
hells-paradise-manga.author: Yuji Kaku

look-back.summary: A short, heartbreaking story about two young artists who are complete opposites, united by their shared passion for drawing, through the years and hardships that shape their friendship and their art.
look-back.author: Tatsuki Fujimoto

witch-hat-atelier.summary: In a world where magic is learned by precisely drawing symbols, a young girl accidentally discovers a forbidden way to cast spells without training, and is taken in by a mysterious witch to learn the true art of magic.
witch-hat-atelier.author: Kamome Shirahama

blame.summary: In an endless, largely automated urban megastructure, a silent man wanders in search of a gene that can restore contact with the network controlling the world, battling hostile cybernetic creatures in a dizzying, oppressive setting.
blame.author: Tsutomu Nihei

apothecary-diaries-manga.summary: The manga adaptation of the hit novel: in imperial China, a young apothecary sold as a servant to the palace uses her knowledge of herbs to solve the mysteries shaking the court.
apothecary-diaries-manga.author: Natsu Hyuuga (story), Itsuki Nanao (art)

mushoku-tensei-manga.summary: The manga adaptation of the hit novel: a Japanese shut-in reincarnated as a baby in a world of magic resolves to live this second chance to the fullest, without the regrets of his previous life.
mushoku-tensei-manga.author: Rifujin na Magonote (story), Yuka Fujikawa (art)

naruto-manga.summary: The original work following Naruto Uzumaki, a young ninja shunned by his village because of the demon sealed inside him, on his quest to become Hokage and earn the recognition he has been denied.
naruto-manga.author: Masashi Kishimoto

one-piece-manga.summary: The original work following Luffy and his crew across the Grand Line in search of the Pirate King's legendary treasure: the best-selling manga of all time.
one-piece-manga.author: Eiichiro Oda

death-note-manga.summary: The original work following Light Yagami, a brilliant high schooler turned self-proclaimed vigilante thanks to a notebook that can kill, locked in a battle of wits with the detective L.
death-note-manga.author: Tsugumi Ohba (story), Takeshi Obata (art)

bleach-manga.summary: The original work following Ichigo Kurosaki, a high schooler turned Substitute Soul Reaper, tasked with protecting souls from evil spirits in a parallel world ruled by fearsome hierarchies.
bleach-manga.author: Tite Kubo

mha-manga.summary: The original work following Izuku Midoriya, a teenager born without a power in a world where most people have one, who joins a prestigious hero academy to achieve his dream.
mha-manga.author: Kohei Horikoshi

demon-slayer-manga.summary: The original work following Tanjiro Kamado, a young charcoal seller turned demon slayer after his family's massacre, searching for a cure for his sister, who has been turned into a demon.
demon-slayer-manga.author: Koyoharu Gotouge

aot-manga.summary: The original work following Eren Jaeger in a world shut away behind enormous walls against the Titans, whose political plot and twists left a lasting mark on the seinen genre.
aot-manga.title: Attack on Titan
aot-manga.author: Hajime Isayama

fairy-tail-manga.summary: The original work following Lucy Heartfilia and Natsu Dragneel in the Fairy Tail mages' guild, famous for its members' unwavering loyalty despite its chaotic missions.
fairy-tail-manga.author: Hiro Mashima

hxh-manga.summary: The original work following Gon Freecss on his quest to become a Hunter and find his father, known for its complex story arcs and frequent publication hiatuses.
hxh-manga.author: Yoshihiro Togashi

rurouni-kenshin-manga.summary: The original work following Kenshin Himura, a former legendary assassin of the Bakumatsu era who swore never to kill again, wandering Meiji Japan to atone for his past.
rurouni-kenshin-manga.author: Nobuhiro Watsuki

inuyasha-manga.summary: The original work following Kagome Higurashi, a middle schooler sent to feudal Japan, and Inuyasha, a half-dog demon she frees from his seal, searching for the shards of a cursed jewel.
inuyasha-manga.author: Rumiko Takahashi

yu-yu-hakusho-manga.summary: The original work following Yusuke Urameshi, a delinquent high schooler turned Spirit Detective after his heroic death, tasked with investigating demon incursions into the human world.
yu-yu-hakusho-manga.author: Yoshihiro Togashi

trigun-manga.summary: The original work following Vash the Stampede, a pacifist gunman with a record bounty wandering a desert planet, chased by bounty hunters and haunted by a destructive past.
trigun-manga.author: Yasuhiro Nightow

gintama-manga.summary: The original work following Gintoki Sakata, a jaded former warrior running an odd-jobs agency in an alternate Edo invaded by aliens, between wild parody and moments of unexpected seriousness.
gintama-manga.author: Hideaki Sorachi

sailor-moon-manga.summary: The original work following Usagi Tsukino, a middle schooler revealed to be the reincarnation of a legendary warrior tasked with protecting Earth: a founding pillar of the magical girl genre.
sailor-moon-manga.author: Naoko Takeuchi

hajime-no-ippo-manga.summary: The original work following Ippo Makunouchi, a shy, bullied high schooler who discovers his calling for boxing, one of the longest-running and most respected sports manga.
hajime-no-ippo-manga.author: George Morikawa

parasyte-manga.summary: The original work following Shinichi Izumi, a high schooler forced to coexist with an alien parasite living in his right hand, facing other parasites that have taken over entire humans.
parasyte-manga.author: Hitoshi Iwaaki

elfen-lied-manga.summary: The original work following Lucy, a mutant with devastating invisible arms who escaped a military lab, taken in by two young people who know nothing about her violent nature.
elfen-lied-manga.author: Lynn Okamoto

fruits-basket-manga.summary: The original work following Tohru Honda, an orphaned high school girl taken in by a family whose members turn into zodiac animals, a classic of dramatic shojo.
fruits-basket-manga.author: Natsuki Takaya

your-lie-in-april-manga.summary: The original work following Kosei Arima, a piano prodigy paralyzed by trauma, whose meeting with a flamboyant violinist brings back his love of music and of life.
your-lie-in-april-manga.author: Naoshi Arakawa

assassination-classroom-manga.summary: The original work following a class of middle schoolers tasked with assassinating their teacher, an overpowered creature threatening Earth, before the end of the school year.
assassination-classroom-manga.author: Yusei Matsui

seven-deadly-sins-manga.summary: The original work following Meliodas and the scattered members of a legendary order of knights, wrongly accused of treason, recruited by a princess on the run to take back her kingdom.
seven-deadly-sins-manga.author: Nakaba Suzuki

kaguya-sama-manga.summary: The original work following Kaguya Shinomiya and Miyuki Shirogane, two top students at an elite high school who are each too proud to confess first, in a psychological war as absurd as it is hilarious.
kaguya-sama-manga.author: Aka Akasaka

mob-psycho-manga.summary: The original work following Shigeo "Mob" Kageyama, a middle schooler with colossal psychic powers who tries to suppress his emotions so he never loses control, working part-time for a fake psychic.
mob-psycho-manga.author: ONE

black-clover-manga.summary: The original work following Asta, a boy born without any magic in a world where magic determines social status, who still dreams of becoming the most powerful mage in the kingdom.
black-clover-manga.author: Yuki Tabata

haikyu-manga.summary: The original work following Shoyo Hinata, a short high schooler passionate about volleyball who joins a team that is rebuilding, determined to prove that height isn't everything on the court.
haikyu-manga.author: Haruichi Furudate

soul-eater.summary: At an academy that trains soul reapers alongside human weapons that can transform, a trio of students trains to collect the souls of criminals to forge the perfect blade of a legendary scythe.
soul-eater.author: Atsushi Ohkubo

claymore.summary: In a world ravaged by man-eating creatures, half-human, half-demon warriors called Claymores are tasked with eliminating these monsters, at the cost of an ever more fragile inner balance.
claymore.author: Norihiro Yagi

tokyo-revengers-manga.summary: The original work following Takemichi Hanagaki, a young man with no future who can travel back into his own past, trying to change the course of events to save the people he loved in middle school.
tokyo-revengers-manga.author: Ken Wakui

spy-x-family-manga.summary: The original work following Loid Forger, an elite spy forced to build a fake family for an undercover mission, unaware that his wife is an assassin and his daughter a telepath.
spy-x-family-manga.author: Tatsuya Endo

bocchi-manga.summary: The original work following Hitori Gotoh, a high school guitarist with crazy talent but crippling social anxiety, who dreams of joining a band.
bocchi-manga.author: Aki Hamaji

ranking-of-kings-manga.summary: The original work following Bojji, a small, deaf young prince underestimated by his kingdom, who still dreams of becoming the greatest king in history alongside a mysterious shadow who has become his friend.
ranking-of-kings-manga.author: Sōsuke Tōka

devilman.summary: Go Nagai's founding manga following Akira Fudo, a pure-hearted teenager merged with a demon to fight demons from within, a pioneering and still provocative work of the horror genre.
devilman.author: Go Nagai

toradora-manga.summary: The manga adaptation of the hit novel: a high schooler with an intimidating face and a tiny classmate with an explosive temper team up to help each other win over the people they love.
toradora-manga.author: Yuyuko Takemiya (novel), Zekkyo (manga)

dr-stone-manga.summary: The original work following Senku Ishigami, a science-genius high schooler who sets out to rebuild civilization from scratch after a worldwide petrification, relying on the scientific method.
dr-stone-manga.author: Riichiro Inagaki (story), Boichi (art)

kuroko-manga.summary: At Seirin High, Taiga Kagami meets Tetsuya Kuroko, a player with an almost invisible presence and a former member of the legendary "Generation of Miracles". Together they try to beat their former teammates with superhuman talent to become the best in Japan.
kuroko-manga.author: Tadatoshi Fujimaki

prince-of-tennis-manga.summary: Ryoma Echizen, a young tennis prodigy back from the United States, enters Seishun Gakuen Middle School. He faces ever more formidable rivals at the national tournament, with ever more spectacular techniques.
prince-of-tennis-manga.author: Takeshi Konomi

ace-of-diamond-manga.summary: Eijun Sawamura, a countryside pitcher without a real team, is recruited by prestigious Seido High, a big name in high school baseball. He enters a tough internal competition to become the ace and play at Koshien.
ace-of-diamond-manga.author: Yuji Terajima

eyeshield-21-manga.summary: Sena Kobayakawa, a shy high schooler used to being everyone's punching bag, is drafted into his school's American football team by the devilish Hiruma. His extraordinary speed turns him into the mysterious Eyeshield 21.
eyeshield-21-manga.author: Riichiro Inagaki / Yusuke Murata

ping-pong-manga.summary: Two childhood friends, Peco and Smile, play in their high school's table tennis club. One is exuberant and sure of his talent, the other cold and withdrawn, and their relationship with the sport is shaken by the arrival of new rivals.
ping-pong-manga.author: Taiyo Matsumoto

dungeon-meshi-manga.summary: After his sister is eaten by a dragon in a dungeon, Laios and his party set off again with few resources. To survive, they decide to cook the monsters they meet, with the help of the dwarf Senshi.
dungeon-meshi-manga.author: Ryoko Kui

kaiju-no-8-manga.summary: In a Japan regularly attacked by monsters called kaiju, Kafka Hibino, a thirty-something corpse cleaner, dreams of joining the Defense Force. After swallowing a small kaiju, he gains the power to turn into a monster and must hide his secret.
kaiju-no-8-manga.author: Naoya Matsumoto

sakamoto-days-manga.summary: Taro Sakamoto, a legend among hitmen, retired to run a convenience store with his family, which made him put on a lot of weight. When his past catches up with him, he must defend his peaceful life with the help of his friends.
sakamoto-days-manga.author: Yuto Suzuki

mashle-manga.summary: In a world where magic determines social status, Mash Burnedead is born without any magic but with colossal physical strength. To live in peace with his adoptive family, he enters a magic academy and must become a "Divine Visionary".
mashle-manga.author: Hajime Komoto

undead-unluck-manga.summary: Andy is immortal and Fuko carries bad luck that kills anyone who touches her. Together they team up to find a way to die for one and to touch others for the other. Their quest leads them to the Union, an organization of people with strange powers.
undead-unluck-manga.author: Yoshifumi Tozuka

fire-force-manga.summary: In a world where some humans spontaneously combust and become monsters called Infernals, the Special Fire Force fights to stop them. Shinra Kusakabe, nicknamed "the Devil", joins Company 8 to uncover the mystery of the fire that killed his family.
fire-force-manga.author: Atsushi Ohkubo

noragami-manga.summary: Yato is a minor god without a shrine who takes any small job for five yen. Meeting Hiyori, a high school girl whose soul slips out of her body, and his weapon spirit Yukine changes his life as a wandering god.
noragami-manga.author: Adachitoka

blue-exorcist-manga.summary: Rin Okumura learns he is the son of Satan and has inherited devastating blue flames. To fight his father, he decides to become an exorcist and enters True Cross Academy, where he reunites with his twin brother Yukio.
blue-exorcist-manga.author: Kazue Kato

akame-ga-kill-manga.summary: Tatsumi, a young villager, travels to the capital to earn money and save his village. There he discovers the Empire's corruption and joins Night Raid, a group of assassins fighting the regime.
akame-ga-kill-manga.author: Takahiro / Tetsuya Tashiro

magi-manga.summary: In a world inspired by the Arabian Nights, the young magician Aladdin and his friend Alibaba explore mysterious dungeons that hold colossal powers. Their quest soon becomes entangled with politics and the struggle between great kingdoms.
magi-manga.author: Shinobu Ohtaka

hellsing-manga.summary: The Hellsing Organization protects England from vampires and other creatures of the night. Its most fearsome weapon is Alucard, an ancient vampire in its service, facing a Nazi enemy preparing for total war.
hellsing-manga.author: Kohta Hirano

kaiji-manga.summary: Kaiji Ito, a young man with no future buried in debt, agrees to board the ship Espoir to play high-stakes games, at the risk of losing everything. Cunning, psychology and betrayal dominate these high-tension duels.
kaiji-manga.author: Nobuyuki Fukumoto

nana-manga.summary: Two young women both named Nana, with opposite personalities, meet on the train to Tokyo and become roommates. One dreams of making it in music with her punk band, the other is looking for love and meaning in her life.
nana-manga.author: Ai Yazawa

ouran-manga.summary: Haruhi Fujioka, a scholarship student at prestigious Ouran Academy, breaks an outrageously expensive vase and must pay it back by joining the Host Club, a circle of handsome boys who entertain their admirers. Her androgynous looks lead her to work there as a host.
ouran-manga.author: Bisco Hatori

horimiya-manga.summary: Kyoko Hori, a popular high school girl, has a busy family life outside of class. She discovers that Izumi Miyamura, a classmate known as gloomy and quiet, hides piercings and tattoos. Growing closer changes their daily lives.
horimiya-manga.author: HERO / Daisuke Hagiwara

my-dress-up-darling-manga.summary: Wakana Gojo, a lonely high schooler passionate about traditional hina dolls, bonds with Marin Kitagawa, an outgoing classmate who loves cosplay. He decides to make her costumes, and their collaboration turns into a sincere friendship.
my-dress-up-darling-manga.author: Shinichi Fukuda

grand-blue-manga.summary: Iori Kitahara moves to a coastal town to study at university. He gets roped into the diving club, where people drink far more than they dive. Absurd humor and situations worthy of the sea.
grand-blue-manga.author: Kenji Inoue / Kimitake Yoshioka

solo-leveling-manga.summary: In a world where portals open onto monster-filled dungeons, Jin-Woo Sung is considered the weakest hunter. After an ordeal that nearly costs him his life, he gains a strange system that lets him grow stronger without limit.
solo-leveling-manga.author: Chugong / Dubu / Jang Sung-rak

real-manga.summary: After accidents or injuries, three men come together through wheelchair basketball, which becomes a way to rebuild themselves. A realistic portrait of disability, the will to live and sportsmanship.
real-manga.author: Takehiko Inoue

ashita-no-joe.summary: Joe Yabuki, a young delinquent from the Tokyo slums, is spotted by former boxer Danpei Tange, who trains him. A boxing career opens up for him, marked by grueling fights.
ashita-no-joe.author: Asao Takamori / Tetsuya Chiba

blue-giant.summary: Dai Miyamoto, a high schooler from Sendai, discovers jazz and decides to become the best saxophonist in the world. He moves to Tokyo, where he forms a trio with a pianist and a drummer.
blue-giant.author: Shinichi Ishizuka

tomie.summary: Tomie Kawakami is a beautiful girl who fascinates everyone who comes near her. Even dismembered, she regenerates, and her presence drives those who desire her to madness or murder. Short stories, each centered on one of her reincarnations.
tomie.author: Junji Ito

gyo.summary: During a stay in Okinawa, Tadashi and his girlfriend Kaori see fish invading dry land on mechanical legs. A stench of death accompanies this plague as it spreads across the whole country.
gyo.author: Junji Ito

black-butler-manga.summary: Ciel Phantomhive, the Queen of England's watchdog, solves London's darkest cases with the help of Sebastian, his demon butler. A gothic manga where each investigation brings Ciel closer to the truth about the night that destroyed his family.
black-butler-manga.author: Yana Toboso

food-wars-manga.summary: Soma Yukihira takes on the best students of Totsuki Academy in high-stakes cooking duels. A manga where every dish is a battle, with mouthwatering illustrations.
food-wars-manga.author: Yuto Tsukuda, Shun Saeki

quintuplets-manga.summary: Futaro Uesugi has to tutor five identical sisters who refuse to learn. Over the high school years, one of them will become his future wife, and the manga keeps the mystery until the very end.
quintuplets-manga.author: Negi Haruba

mushishi-manga.summary: Ginko, a traveling mushi master, meets people affected by mushi, primitive life forms on the edge of the visible. A manga of short, sensitive and poetic stories about nature and humanity's place in it.
mushishi-manga.author: Yuki Urushibara

dororo-manga.summary: Hyakkimaru, robbed of his body at birth by a demonic pact, hunts the 48 demons who hold each of its parts. With the thief Dororo, he crosses a war-torn feudal Japan in a classic by the master Osamu Tezuka.
dororo-manga.author: Osamu Tezuka

to-your-eternity-manga.summary: Fushi, an immortal being who can copy whatever it touches, discovers love, friendship and loss through encounters spanning the ages. A heartbreaking manga about what it means to live, by the author of A Silent Voice.
to-your-eternity-manga.author: Yoshitoki Oima

detective-conan-manga.summary: Shrunk ten years younger, Shinichi Kudo investigates under the identity of Conan. One of the longest-running and most popular detective manga in Japan.
detective-conan-manga.author: Gosho Aoyama

initial-d-manga.summary: Takumi Fujiwara, a tofu delivery boy, becomes a legendary drift racer on Japan's mountain passes. A cult manga for fans of cars, mechanics and night racing.
initial-d-manga.author: Shuuichi Shigeno

bungo-stray-dogs-manga.summary: Detectives with powers inspired by great writers face the Yokohama mafia. A manga mixing investigations, fights and literary references.
bungo-stray-dogs-manga.author: Kafka Asagiri, Sango Harukawa

ajin-manga.summary: Kei Nagai becomes the authorities' target when he discovers he is an immortal ajin. A dark seinen full of duels and twists.
ajin-manga.author: Gamon Sakurai, Tsuina Miura

chihayafuru-manga.summary: A sports manga about karuta, where every game of poetry cards becomes a duel of wits and memory.
chihayafuru-manga.author: Yuki Suetsugu

tower-of-god-manga.summary: A Korean webtoon first published online: Bam climbs the Tower to find Rachel and faces ever more complex floors.
tower-of-god-manga.author: SIU

blue-period-manga.summary: A model high school student discovers art and throws himself into it body and soul. A sensitive manga about creation, doubt and perseverance.
blue-period-manga.author: Tsubasa Yamaguchi

bakuman-manga.summary: From the creators of Death Note: the journey of two friends aiming to get published in Jump, and the birth of a manga-artist duo.
bakuman-manga.author: Tsugumi Ooba, Takeshi Obata

dragon-ball-manga.summary: Akira Toriyama's manga that launched the franchise: Goku and his friends travel the world to gather the Dragon Balls and face the greatest fighters.
dragon-ball-manga.author: Akira Toriyama

ranma-manga.summary: Rumiko Takahashi's manga: martial arts, a water curse and romantic comedy, a classic of comedic shonen.
ranma-manga.author: Rumiko Takahashi

saint-seiya-manga.summary: Masami Kurumada's manga: the Bronze Saints take on the Sanctuary to save Athena, through the twelve houses of the Zodiac.
saint-seiya-manga.author: Masami Kurumada

cardcaptor-sakura-manga.summary: A work by the CLAMP collective: the story of Sakura, who captures the Clow Cards with her friends, mixing magic, tenderness and costumes.
cardcaptor-sakura-manga.author: CLAMP

fist-of-the-north-star-manga.summary: Buronson and Tetsuo Hara's manga: Kenshiro, last heir of Hokuto Shinken, roams a world in ruins.
fist-of-the-north-star-manga.author: Buronson, Tetsuo Hara

gachiakuta-manga.summary: A raw shonen with an urban art style: Rudo, rejected by his world, fights in the Abyss using discarded objects.
gachiakuta-manga.author: Kei Urana

natsume-yuujinchou-manga.summary: Yuki Midorikawa's manga: Natsume returns their names to the spirits his grandmother captured, between tenderness and melancholy.
natsume-yuujinchou-manga.author: Yuki Midorikawa

promised-neverland-manga.summary: Emma, Norman and Ray live happily at Grace Field orphanage, until the day they discover the children are being raised like livestock for demons. They attempt a daring escape plan.
promised-neverland-manga.author: Kaiu Shirai (story), Posuka Demizu (art)

oyasumi-punpun-manga.summary: Punpun Onodera, drawn as a simple bird, grows up between dreams, childhood love and disillusionment. A raw, moving portrait of adolescence and adulthood.
oyasumi-punpun-manga.author: Inio Asano

kimi-ni-todoke-manga.summary: Sawako Kuronuma, a shy high school girl nicknamed Sadako because of her looks, grows close to Kazehaya, a popular and kind boy. A story of friendship and sincere love.
kimi-ni-todoke-manga.author: Karuho Shiina

black-lagoon-manga.summary: Rokuro Okajima, a Japanese office worker kidnapped by pirates, joins the Lagoon Company, which delivers illicit cargo in Southeast Asia. Gunfights and dark humor in a lawless world.
black-lagoon-manga.author: Rei Hiroe

akane-banashi-manga.summary: Akane Osaki, daughter of a rakugo storyteller expelled from his troupe, decides to become a rakugo performer to avenge her father. She trains to take the stage and beat renowned storytellers.
akane-banashi-manga.author: Yuki Suenaga (story), Takamasa Moue (art)

rent-a-girlfriend-manga.summary: Kazuya Kinoshita, a dumped student, rents a girlfriend, Chizuru Mizuhara, to console himself. This date triggers a series of misunderstandings mixing lies, love and comedy.
rent-a-girlfriend-manga.author: Reiji Miyajima

tonikaku-kawaii-manga.summary: Nasa Yuzaki, a brilliant high schooler, proposes to Tsukasa, a girl he met by chance, who accepts on one condition. Their newlywed life mixes everyday moments, tenderness and humor.
tonikaku-kawaii-manga.author: Kenjiro Hata

gantz-manga.summary: Kei Kurono and Masaru Kato die under a subway train and find themselves in an apartment where a black sphere, Gantz, sends them to hunt aliens. A violent, dark manga that questions life and death.
gantz-manga.author: Hiroya Oku

land-of-the-lustrous-manga.summary: In the distant future, beings made of gemstones, the Gems, fight the Lunarians, who want to carry them off. Phosphophyllite, fragile and useless, looks for a purpose. A sublime manga with remarkably delicate art.
land-of-the-lustrous-manga.author: Haruko Ichikawa

pandora-hearts-manga.summary: Oz, heir to a noble family, is cast into the Abyss, the prison of the Chains. He makes a contract with Alice, a mysterious Chain, and uncovers the secrets of Pandora. Dark fantasy with a dense plot.
pandora-hearts-manga.author: Jun Mochizuki

yona-of-the-dawn-manga.summary: Yona, a carefree princess, sees her father murdered by her cousin and flees with her bodyguard Hak. She sets out to find the four dragons to take back her kingdom. A heartfelt adventure shojo.
yona-of-the-dawn-manga.author: Mizuho Kusanagi

blue-box-manga.summary: Taiki, a badminton player, admires Chinatsu, a basketball star. When she moves into his house, they encourage each other to reach their dreams. A sincere sports romance.
blue-box-manga.author: Kouji Miura

skip-and-loafer-manga.summary: Mitsumi, a brilliant student from the countryside, moves to Tokyo and meets Sosuke and their classmates. A tender, funny high school slice-of-life comedy.
skip-and-loafer-manga.author: Misaki Takamatsu

the-dangers-in-my-heart-manga.summary: Kyotaro, a shy high schooler with dark thoughts, secretly admires popular Anna. Their awkward moments of closeness make for a touching school romance.
the-dangers-in-my-heart-manga.author: Norio Sakurai

zom-100-manga.summary: Akira, an exhausted employee, is thrilled by the zombie apocalypse and writes a list of a hundred things to do before becoming a zombie. A horror comedy with a liberating tone.
zom-100-manga.author: Haro Aso (story), Kotaro Takata (art)

toilet-bound-hanako-kun-manga.summary: Nene, a high school girl, summons Hanako, the ghost of the school toilets, to grant a wish, and becomes his assistant in investigating the school's seven mysteries. The supernatural, full of humor and emotion.
toilet-bound-hanako-kun-manga.author: AidaIro

iruma-kun-manga.summary: Iruma, sold to a demon by his parents, is adopted by him and enrolled in a school for demons, where he must hide that he is human. A very popular fantasy comedy.
iruma-kun-manga.author: Osamu Nishi

shangri-la-frontier-manga.summary: Rakuro, a specialist in broken games, takes on the challenge of the virtual reality game Shangri-La Frontier, where he becomes a legendary player. A spectacular video game manga.
shangri-la-frontier-manga.author: Katarina (story), Ryosuke Fuji (art)

aoashi-manga.summary: Ashito Aoi, a gifted but naive high schooler from the countryside, is spotted by a Tokyo coach and joins a youth club. A demanding, realistic football manga.
aoashi-manga.author: Yuugo Kobayashi

major-manga.summary: Goro, son of a baseball player who died, grows up dreaming of playing in the major leagues. A long sports manga, from childhood to a pro career.
major-manga.author: Takuya Mitsuda

captain-tsubasa-manga.summary: Tsubasa Ozora, passionate about football, dreams of winning the World Cup with his country. A legendary manga that inspired a whole generation of footballers.
captain-tsubasa-manga.author: Yoichi Takahashi

hikaru-no-go-manga.summary: Hikaru finds an old go board haunted by the spirit of Sai, a go player from the past. He takes up the game and meets Akira Toya, his rival. A manga that popularized go.
hikaru-no-go-manga.author: Yumi Hotta (story), Takeshi Obata (art)

platinum-end-manga.summary: Mirai, a high schooler in despair, is saved at the last moment by an angel, who gives him wings and arrows. He enters a competition between twelve candidates to become the next god.
platinum-end-manga.author: Tsugumi Ohba (story), Takeshi Obata (art)

usogui-manga.summary: Baku Madarame, a gambler nicknamed "the Liar Eater", faces opponents in deadly games. Psychological duels and intense bluffing: a must-read gambling manga.
usogui-manga.author: Toshio Sako

liar-game-manga.summary: Nao, a naive young woman, is thrown into a money game where every contestant has to lie to win. She teams up with Akiyama, a genius con man, to outsmart the traps.
liar-game-manga.author: Shinobu Kaitani

tokyo-ghoul-re-manga.summary: The sequel to Tokyo Ghoul: Kaneki, now Haise Sasaki, mentors a CCG squad. His past catches up with him in a dark clash between ghouls and humans.
tokyo-ghoul-re-manga.author: Sui Ishida

kakegurui-manga.summary: In a high school where gambling determines social rank, Yumeko Jabami challenges the elite for the love of risk. Betting games and madness in an extravagant atmosphere.
kakegurui-manga.author: Homura Kawamoto (story), Toru Naomura (art)

prison-school-manga.summary: Five boys at Hachimitsu Academy, until now a girls-only school, are locked in a "prison" after a stupid stunt. A very provocative comedy with no-limits humor.
prison-school-manga.author: Akira Hiramoto

boruto-two-blue-vortex-manga.summary: After a time skip, Boruto has disappeared and Kawaki has become a hero of the Hidden Leaf. The direct sequel to Boruto: Naruto Next Generations, centered on the clash between the two former friends.
boruto-two-blue-vortex-manga.author: Masashi Kishimoto (supervision), Mikio Ikemoto (art)

kagurabachi-manga.summary: Chihiro, son of a swordsmith, hunts down his father's murderers, armed with one of his father's legendary blades. A tense, much-talked-about action shonen.
kagurabachi-manga.author: Takeru Hokazono

witch-watch-manga.summary: Morihito, an ogre high schooler, must protect Nico, his childhood friend and a witch who moves back in with him. A lively magical comedy by the author of Sket Dance.
witch-watch-manga.author: Kenta Shinohara

medalist-manga.summary: Inori, a middle school girl who dreams of figure skating, meets former skater Tsukasa and becomes his student. A moving sports manga about ambition and perseverance.
medalist-manga.author: Tsurumaikada

fire-punch-manga.summary: In a frozen world, Agni, burned by an inextinguishable flame, is consumed by revenge. A dark, provocative manga by Tatsuki Fujimoto, author of Chainsaw Man.
fire-punch-manga.author: Tatsuki Fujimoto

mieruko-chan-manga.summary: Miko suddenly starts seeing supernatural creatures, but decides to act as if nothing is happening. A horror comedy with situations as funny as they are stressful.
mieruko-chan-manga.author: Tomoki Izumi

barakamon-manga.summary: Handa, a talented calligrapher, is exiled to the Goto Islands, where little Naru and the locals invade his life. A countryside slice-of-life manga full of warmth and humor.
barakamon-manga.author: Satsuki Yoshino

silver-spoon-manga.summary: Hachiken, a city boy looking for direction, enrolls at an agricultural high school in Hokkaido. He learns farm work and the value of life. A sincere comedy by the author of Fullmetal Alchemist.
silver-spoon-manga.author: Hiromu Arakawa

a-silent-voice-manga.summary: Shoya, who bullied Shoko, a deaf classmate, tries to make amends years later. A moving manga about bullying, guilt and forgiveness.
a-silent-voice-manga.author: Yoshitoki Oima

orange-manga.summary: Naho receives a letter from her future self asking her to prevent the death of Kakeru, a new student in her class. A fantasy romance about regrets and friendship.
orange-manga.author: Ichigo Takano

nodame-cantabile-manga.summary: Chiaki, an ambitious pianist, meets the messy and brilliant Nodame. Together they find their way in the world of classical music. The original manga behind the anime.
